#
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ee8d2b0c786843d8a6edebe913e4af98&_e=sxA9GGYR-_26ydjBk_hgScJepgr2K87hT0ptMlaEL404kYYsqwxRPC3nc2qNtgebIQsvzgHd7BDP3LBfONQr3aMFgwPk8yk11p0oS-qJS46KHDq7MeMbZmnhA3tc4Pwlb8R0XppmGaX2ghJldO2WKwF-JnFq-xgr-PEwHTV3uEU88YnmjMuISTbzbln873shRwc2OSOWBR1Q2eFpht-fQ1y8Z7a-XQmNkk5__VwuO-ZAefPzvltb3MBcHqPL4mcIzRfX98oDW0KklZo0mmQPmyb0Ou-xNpA5aoFUX24sM4LFjaa264w2L5sEi7cCBibIX9xEkF9U0L1CYbiROKiYL1ncuUqBnk5HK_DWHiKqoQo%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. Use this secure link to make your gift and kick Planned Parenthood out of the classroom! [https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ee8d2b0c786843d8a6edebe913e4af98&_e=sxA9GGYR-_26ydjBk_hgScJepgr2K87hT0ptMlaEL404kYYsqwxRPC3nc2qNtgebIQsvzgHd7BDP3LBfONQr3aMFgwPk8yk11p0oS-qJS46KHDq7MeMbZmnhA3tc4Pwlb8R0XppmGaX2ghJldO2WKwF-JnFq-xgr-PEwHTV3uEU88YnmjMuISTbzbln873shRwc2OSOWBR1Q2eFpht-fQ1m5ZUy_kHfEU1faoCzJnAW1uCohYIfxnNTWYQfL4pPMSL3dmEJQgjtOsCBTv4HyLVtv93Saw0oWZk0gz8gNNnpmrDHIiriTz5IVE3O4yYF_sm3ZwbJ6ZWvt3bmOu6KAcOFhySFQEx8iEnboPu-FZg8%3D)

Your partnership gives me so much hope. I can't wait to share the impact your activism will have in months to come. Our children - and grandchildren - depend on it.

For Life,

Lila Rose

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: they were so mad! 🤣
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

As you may recall, last week, the Supreme Court heard two major cases on whether deadly Chemical Abortion Pills should remain on the market.

Any time the U.S. Supreme Court takes up an abortion-related case, it’s a news and PR madhouse in Washington, D.C.

So, when the pro-abortion mob showed up to try and rally the media for their cause and found our all-student _**SCOTUS Squad**_ already stealing the show, they were FURIOUS!
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-surhdhy-duchtdja-y/)
In fact, one of our student activists who you may recognize, Lydia Taylor, had a radical pro-abortion woman literally spit in her face from screaming at her so closely . . . not to mention the several middle fingers also flying in her face.

Their reaction proves that our _**SCOTUS Squad**_ had exactly the effect we wanted, as the pro-abortion spin they were hoping for was ruined by our presence!

Of course, the fight against Chemical Abortion Pills is still far from over, as _Students for Life Action_ is battling on multiple fronts against these deadly pills – _which I’ll share with you shortly._

**[But first, would you please consider making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to aid us in our GENERATIONAL BATTLE against Chemical Abortion](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-surhdhy-duchtdja-j/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, ever since the Supreme Court’s historic reversal of _Roe v. Wade,_ Chemical Abortion Pills have become the Abortion Lobby’s new favorite killing machine.

In fact, a study I just saw from the Guttmacher Institute _(Planned Parenthood’s research arm),_ shows that Chemical Abortions now make up over **60%** of all abortions!

And it’s probably more as many of these pills are actually trafficked into states with pro-life abortion prevention laws by abortion radicals who want to keep killing babies.

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ has been fighting on all fronts including with:

\- Our 160-stop, 40-state _“Stop Abortion Extremism”_ National Tour, which is turning young people away from the Abortion Lobby in droves by exposing them to the reality of abortion; and

\- Our efforts to force the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to monitor for trace elements of harmful abortion chemicals and aborted remains of preborn babies in our water supply.
You see, our _**SCOTUS Squad**_ effort at the Supreme Court was just one small part of our GENERATIONAL BATTLE we are waging against Chemical Abortion Pills – _but it was a critical one._

The two cases they are deciding right now – _FDA v. Alliance for Hypocritic Medicine_ and _Danco Laboratories v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine_ – could not be more critical as:

• Walgreens and CVS have begun selling Chemical Abortion Pills, turning your local pharmacy in an abortion mill;

• At least 32 women _(that we know of)_ have died after taking these dangerous pills;

• Pro-abortion radicals are flooding states – _even those with pro-life laws_ – with these deadly pills; and

• Our country’s water supply is being poisoned as the bodies of the little babies who are killed by abortion are flushed into our waterways – and water treatment plants don’t treat for trace abortion chemicals, _which are known endocrine disruptors,_ or fetal remains.
With the future of Chemical Abortion hanging in the balance, the lives of innocent preborn babies, _and their moms,_ are on the line!

And while we pray the Supreme Court makes the right decision, I know that can’t be the extent of our action!

**We must fight!**

**[So, would you please consider making your most generous contribution of $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to _Students for Life Action_ to aid us in our GENERATIONAL BATTLE against Chemical Abortion](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-surhdhy-duchtdja-i/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: Consider...
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z27g8ghqcsg5sb514vaieeuat9vufidh6h4j1qh0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chgm4o32clh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1ueua6lvl110j6is3jboum9boje4eh0e4d5pnjg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chgm4o32clh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrtmirfi8mflf6sc1ea0u1u3p2u44b7f4hj197do_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chgm4o34c3h2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5jvjn64sj0s2dbdc6msq131l03g7gvpel9p12c8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chgm4o34c3h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkaptf1dq84puk2s751i5fr3l7kbc050li3mj6m8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chgm4o34c3h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| 1600 Daily

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g5pzOl4b8blMv3FQ0AVIXQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn77O4P0S-aHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2VsZWN0b3JhbC1jb2xsZWdlLXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDA1ODROMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWVsZWN0b3JhbF9jb2xsZWdlX3N1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ZRVNOT1NIT1JUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQwM1cDc3BjQgpmBIsXDWZqNHU-UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) [NO](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g5pzOl4b8blMv3FQ0AVIXQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn77O4P0S-aHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2VsZWN0b3JhbC1jb2xsZWdlLXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDA1ODROMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWVsZWN0b3JhbF9jb2xsZWdlX3N1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ZRVNOT1NIT1JUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQwM1cDc3BjQgpmBIsXDWZqNHU-UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g5pzOl4b8blMv3FQ0AVIXQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn77O4P0S-aHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2VsZWN0b3JhbC1jb2xsZWdlLXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDA1ODROMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWVsZWN0b3JhbF9jb2xsZWdlX3N1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1ZRVNOT1NIT1JUX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDQwM1cDc3BjQgpmBIsXDWZqNHU-UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. # [Sign: Investigate whether Trump should be charged with securities fraud for the Truth Social stock crash](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td35cb9d4-fbb3-404d-820e-6d350f6ef68a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Just days after it went public, and its stock price placed its value in the billions, Donald Trump's "Truth Social" crashed back to Earth, with that same stock dropping like a rock. Why? Because the $50 million profit it said it made in 2022 had turned into a [loss of $58 million](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70235fb0-7d75-4aa3-a1de-31e01ba7fdce/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) in 2023 -- with only $4 million in total revenue. In short, it was a disastrous performance -- but the numbers weren't revealed until after the stock went public, meaning those buying the stock were left in the dark until it was too late -- and their investments had collapsed in value. [**Add your name, and demand and that Trump be investigated for securities fraud.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te87314d5-a5f7-458e-9940-1a0fce01d3a1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Maybe this is all legit, and maybe it was simply a case of the most dazzlingly fortunate timing one could hope for. Or maybe critical information was withheld in order to keep the true state of the company out of the spotlight. No doubt, anyone foolish enough to buy into Trump's promises was probably someone who would lose their money on some idiotic venture soon enough. But fraud is fraud, and there are laws, and Donald Trump is not above them. [**Add your name: Investigate whether Trump should be charged with securities fraud for the Truth Social stock crash**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T292a3599-7ce7-407e-90fb-2cf155745bee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

## GOP Bill Would Rename Dulles Airport for Trump
House Republicans introduced legislation Friday [to rename D.C.'s ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAUAL8Gb1jwIDgMDF28pWtH6xmeYypsLMCx-vdVOnc76YbTfT2mB8YU9-cnbuTakif0Lb5o0lxx0JPugluIgFRHTg4S5E0qC93qPNEStFbBDx4BzTKgCgqQ5P3uZ8IuOhCghRZK2JuRtr9bEwBnYwMYM9gb04JCbLn03znubaUl_eQXld7nrUtube2oTH0wGBmM13X1fq47XfXtGYxvZDCGMyWqHGM5cmk85B1T4K2c28HXfFbic0yJwdgVF44rphSrGZgWzw1j-mu1_8Z_AwAA__9CtFuV)Washington Dulles International Airport to the "Donald J. Trump International Airport." The airport is named after Cold War warrior John Foster Dulles, President Dwight Eisenhower's Secretary of State. The other major airport in the area, once known as National Airport, now bears the name of former President Ronald Reagan. Pennsylvania Rep. Guy Reschenthaler [introduced the bill ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNiI4Y5wbGLp4S9eOFoFzfBU2Fsap8vdVOnd9b3jS-7pNt8CZt8dnWMm3uUwhNn7SZFWnwE5WJj8TAXWSvBkMmN50CHLxIRqDVyQTEyAY6I1NDlMcZpOSmVGyBw1WW91p7J3ByxVdgnB3mMC5AXthNSVupV6-C29toTm_ypPqJZZVZr-0th-i-xAwChjbQgvn_HYCxr1kjq83rmE79lJbaFw2AaPtHaI2ainnQarSft4zx7AdqtIWVlLpzJkO1eq57gJGWX3afzhnPtwgrH6sgf8qsv234zcAAP__JNdhmQ)with a half-dozen co-sponsors. Democrats said the bill was unlikely to make it through the Democrat-controlled Senate.
## Iowa-LSU Sets New Betting Record
Monday night's superstar NCAA women's matchup between Iowa and LSU was the [biggest betting event of all time for women's sports](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1jwjHEZGLp4S9eOFjYPmwpDZF6C-vdVMne5y5WOjs73bbm5mGLev9yJlkJZ3EbxiYviAwe1qM7bgAg4dGjlJEGOcjDQHVY5p6QfBzmCgMn7MZhgNjDrNqEyWnfRggAllBiEGbU0_YfRHtyqjQetJzMyJdBHKlf_U2KmA0P6LU-8-q2cXbIH0b2y4ZPBzGBurfVbXrfXyWB-oRnM4j3AYA4u-wcmHktzPNUH392JvLnK17jvWImvSBTzzvGJmXgoF2_lxFx5vZeLan_QmbrL-nuLKcWqJ6bEfrqY3j70X5y_AAAA__-cYmVG), attracting more bets than any sporting event in the country that night. The game featured a rematch between Iowa's Caitlin Clark and LSU's Angel Reese. Last year, LSU beat Iowa for the NCAA championship, but this week Clark dominated with a 94-87 victory--and a 28% increase in total wagering over last year's match. At BetMGM, there were [more proposition bets on Clark Monday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2Yzsw5h48NCFLV07oot9JNcaHMElUf59Recu3_TpPel9naczcuH1-okLRZnrhEn4SZPTnQY3uSbHmQioayjawYLtbReguUUMJnR2cClbS6bHE87oB2v6ZGfrQ244ggFnnOlM6L0N7Sn4DHjxIYP3Q-iVM5RZ6tZ-V17lRnN51ydtbapLU-JN5L6r7kPBqGCc5dU-dpSa8X0cFIwHXsFojuH6Ql32h07IUnjVqeD2oy8kwutVP2t5LKQ3SnXLzRbz_cWl8O4H5cx1QS5_UvmvwG8AAAD__6vPXA4) night than any other pro basketball player, male or female. People wagered on her total points, assists, 3-point shots, and rebounds. Iowa, favored by 1.5 points, attracted the great majority of the bets, making it a profitable night for many gamblers. Sportbook officials say they now see women sports fans as a potentially vast new market for gambling.
## List: Forbes 2024 Ranking of Billionaires
Forbes' annual [list of the world's billionaires](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGP4yAUhH-N3T0LHtiOC4pr3OXaKy0wj5gchghI0N2vX3nr7UYz0syn-XPf7toHHx-_9UmqurTpvfoPbRIEoNxkb5UjQhI9KT5z5CMXC_aHkoJGmi3bEYUmPo7aGHmTdr_tUjvGe6-QoWSSCbaME1-G2zJZ1GZaLE7TvIydZGR9TXl4Jh_rQS78Sx_Kw57OPqij1lfpxK8O1w7X1tqwmxKplSvvcL1kh6tL2VCB4EuF5KAeBC3lYAsYH4JPUftMBS4WOFMmqIeOQB_KYMhdRiMd6uEpg85Rv0MFCinC-S5_4UnOgaH_6Zrqs7KvdrWWae4ke5zah2_a-tN1XwEAAP__RHxyrQ) revealed there are 2,781 billionaires worldwide, worth an estimated $14.2 trillion. This year's list added 141 more billionaires and $2 trillion in assets, both new records. The U.S. has the most billionaires, with 813 versus 473 billionaires in China and India's 200, a record for that country. The usual names like Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, and Bill Gates are in the top 10, but the richest person in the world is businessman Bernard Arnault, who controls the $233 billion LVMH empire built on fashion, cosmetics, and alcohol. Other notable billionaires include newcomers Taylor Swift, with $1.1 billion, and the Hunt family, owners of the Kansas City Chiefs, with $1.4 billion.

**Legislative Update**
In March 2024, several significant legislative actions took place in Congress. Among them, H.R. 1023, aimed at repealing the greenhouse gas reduction fund, narrowly passed with a vote of 209-204, with Representative Luttrell voting in favor. Conversely, H.R. 1102, proposing $1.2 trillion in government spending until September 30, faced opposition from Luttrell, who voted against it, although it passed with a majority. Additionally, H.R. 7023, the Confidence in Clean Water Permitting Act, passed with Luttrell's support, as did resolutions such as H. Res. 86, denouncing carbon taxes, and H. Res. 987, criticizing energy policies. Measures such as H.R. 1121, protecting energy production, and H.R. 7520, safeguarding American data, also received Luttrell's affirmative vote. Notably, resolutions like H. Res. 149, condemning the abduction of Ukrainian children, garnered widespread support, including from Luttrell. Other initiatives included H.R. 7521, protecting against foreign-controlled apps, and H.R. 6276, funding transportation and infrastructure, both of which Luttrell supported. Additionally, bills like H.R. 1752, promoting broadband projects, and H.R. 2799, expanding access to capital, found favor with Luttrell. Finally, H.R. 7511, the Lauren Riley Act, empowering states to sue the federal government over financial crimes committed by undocumented immigrants, passed with Luttrell's approval, as did H.R. 3838, which focused on preventing maternal deaths through federal support for state efforts.

Finally, H.R. 7511, the Lauren Riley Act, empowering states to sue the federal government over financial crimes committed by undocumented immigrants, passed with Luttrell's approval, as did H.R. 3838, which focused on preventing maternal deaths through federal support for state efforts. | | Thank you so much for your continuous support.\- Laura Jones for Congress TX-8 | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Laura Jones for Congress. You may or may not have heard of me, but I'm John James. I served in the US Army for eight years and led two Apache platoons in combat operations in the Iraq War.

During my service, I learned true leadership and the price of freedom. I wouldn't trade those years and experiences for anything in the world. It was truly an honor to serve my country, Friend.

**Service is at the core of who I am.** I refuse to stand by and watch the radical Left destroy the country I fought to defend. That's why I ran for Congress in 2022.

**After a hard-fought race, my Team and I won by LESS THAN 0.5%!** I'm serving my country again, but this time here at home. Fighting for our freedoms in DC has been such an honor. But because we embarrassed the Democrats, they want me _GONE_.

Look, I'm a patriotic veteran and father of three, Friend. Of course that doesn't matter to the Left. _**They can 't stand me because I'm an unapologetic conservative!**_

Peter,
After Kyrsten Sinema decided not to run for re-election last month, we knew we had to move fast.
We committed millions of dollars and went up with our first campaign ad of the cycle across Arizona. That was a tough call.
The hope was that we can keep those advertisements up all the way through Election Day. If we do, we’ll be able to speak directly to Arizona voters and fight back against all of Kari Lake’s attacks. But if our fundraising slows down, Kari Lake could start to drown out our message. She could get the edge on us.
We can’t give her that chance. Winning in Arizona is too important.
Now... we know it’s early in the month. We know we just finished a big push. But we can’t afford to take our foot off the gas. Not until we know this race has been won, and that Kari Lake, Trump, and their MAGA agenda are defeated once and for all.

body:
With the primary election drawing near, our campaign is charging forward! Here are the highlights and updates you don't want to miss!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

With the primary election drawing near, our campaign is charging forward with vigor and determination! From televised debates and candidate forums to meetings and speaking engagements—I'm seizing every opportunity to share my vision for Indiana and discuss tangible strategies to eliminate the state income tax, protect our land, and prioritize mental health initiatives.

Let's hit the highlights!

** SEEN ON SOCIAL: Crouch secures two major endorsements
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ am deeply honored to have received the endorsements of the Indiana Right to Life PAC and Carpenters Local 1005, which represents 1,300 carpenters and joiners in Northwest Indiana!
https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** RECAP: Crouch emerges as clear favorite in Fox 59 and WISH-TV debates
------------------------------------------------------------

At last week's Fox 59 and WISH-TV debates, I made it clear: As governor, I'll put YOU first. That means axing the state income tax, protecting Hoosier farmland, prioritizing mental health, and streamlining government to work for YOU.
https://x.com/Suzanne_Crouch/status/1772764917428265020?s=20&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
WATCH: Fox 59 Debate Highlight Reel (https://www.facebook.com/reel/927839145553817?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
WATCH: WISH-TV Debate Highlight Reel (https://www.instagram.com/reel/C5EnLn0LJ_i/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Regional Chamber of Northeast Indiana
------------------------------------------------------------

Last week, I had the privilege of addressing various groups, including the Regional Chamber of Northeast Indiana, where we discussed critical topics such as the U.S. 30 expansion and initiatives to bolster Indiana's workforce and attract families to our state.

** Kosciusko County Chamber Candidate Forum
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ shared my bold vision for Indiana's economic future at the Kosciusko Chamber of Commerce Candidate Forum!

As Governor, I'll lead the charge to eliminate Indiana's individual income tax, putting an average of $2,000 back in Hoosiers' pockets each year. 👏

** Evansville Freedom Group
------------------------------------------------------------

I had a fantastic time speaking to the Evansville Freedom Group last week about how, as Governor, I️ will eliminate the state income tax, protect Indiana from foreign land grab attempts, and prioritize mental health so all Hoosiers can prosper.

Thank you for having me! 🙌

** Monroe County and Orange County Lincoln Day Dinners
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ had the pleasure of attending two Lincoln Day Dinners last week, with five more on the calendar for this week!

At the Monroe County Lincoln Day Dinner, I was glad to hear from Congressman Jim Banks, the keynote speaker, about how he's taking on the wokeism that's threatening to destroy our country.

Both dinners had great turnouts, with the full strength of our Republican Party being on display!

Huge thanks to the Orange County GOP and Monroe County GOP, as well as their chairs, Robert Henderson, Jr. and Taylor Bryant, for their efforts in organizing these events!

** SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: Team Crouch was out in force last week!
------------------------------------------------------------

I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to Team Crouch, who showed up in force at numerous events throughout the week!

>From the WISH-TV debate to the Chamber forum and beyond, your presence and advocacy are invaluable as we work tirelessly to bring positive change to Indiana.

** ICYMI: Endorsements (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=6de5a458d4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_29_03_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6de5a458d4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

body:

# [Sign: Remove Judge Aileen Cannon from the Trump Case for Bias and Incompetence](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf8b17c54-4d99-4a36-b67c-fd14021c2a56/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Aileen Cannon, the judge in the Trump documents case, has shown herself to be wildly biased and jaw-droppingly incompetent -- and now special counsel Jack Smith has taken the [first step](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0592689d-d874-4cc3-ae0c-d517d373d431/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) on the path to removing and replacing her. [**Show your support: Add your name, and demand that Judge Cannon be removed NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tee78d19b-e771-418d-83fc-38f199a15236/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Cannon, a Trump-appointee, has been bending over backwards to help Trump. She has delayed the trial repeatedly for no good reason, and now is [proposing](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1bdebb2d-2f99-4438-beb8-a2ed8377a920/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) that jurors could consider the documents Trump stole to be his personal property. Jack Smith has hit back hard with a filing against this proposal, and looks poised to follow up with a call for her removal. This is arguably the most important of all the Trump cases, and we can't have it controlled by someone in Trump's back pocket. She needs to go, and the trial needs to proceed as soon as possible. [**Add your name, and demand that Judge Cannon be removed NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T55e1589b-fbda-434f-ba46-19435ff57db0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7a1e8abb-ddef-4f40-8c1a-7b7748321e85/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | Hi, Peter. The long, dark night of ultra-partisan gerrymandering is over, and a new day for democracy now dawns in the Badger State. Recently, a new set of state legislative maps were signed into law for Wisconsin. These maps are graded “A” for fairness by the head of the nonpartisan Princeton Gerrymandering Project. The current maps scored an F. With the stroke of a pen, Wisconsin went from a “democracy desert” to, well, a democracy. This was all possible because of you. [I’m going to ask you to split a $10 donation between the Democratic Party of Wisconsin and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T87f7709b-1145-4bf7-9598-1e8439a2c224/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), but I want to tell you how we got here: Wisconsin’s gerrymandering crisis began in 2011, when Republican lawmakers drew legislative lines that guaranteed even landslide election losses wouldn’t cost them their majorities. The result was one of the most egregious, extreme partisan gerrymanders in American political history. In 2012 and 2018, Wisconsin voters overwhelmingly voted for Democratic majorities in the legislature but Republicans won huge majorities of the seats. In 2020 and 2022, Democrats won major statewide victories, but Republicans won near-supermajorities. All the while, Republican politicians in Wisconsin have used their power to restrict access to the ballot, remove authorities that voters had entrusted to statewide elected officials like the Governor and Attorney General, and smash the freedoms of workers to organize and advocate for themselves. For thirteen years, the democracy-proof legislature has been laying siege to democracy itself. But those statewide victories added up. In 2018, 2020, and 2023, voters built a new progressive majority on the State Supreme Court. By electing Governor Evers and preventing GOP supermajorities, they stopped hard-right maps from being signed into law. And last year, a civic uprising prevented Republicans from impeaching Janet Protasiewicz. In December, the Supreme Court ruled that Wisconsin’s legislative maps were unconstitutional. This wasn’t easy. This team had to knock on doors, call phones, chip in, share our views with friends and online—year after year, election after election, never giving up even when it felt like all was lost. But we did it. Today, the work doesn’t end. The candidate recruitment process now goes into overdrive. And at the same time, we remain vigilant in case Republican politicians in Madison and their allies once again, through the courts or any other strategy, attempt to thwart majority rule. Today, we commit to doing the work, ending the malign speakership of Robin Vos, breaking the GOP supermajority in the State Senate, and paving the way towards a Democratic state Senate majority in 2026. I’d be remiss if I didn’t ask. The number of competitive legislative seats will triple so we’ll need triple the support, Peter. [Can you chip in a $10 split donation between WisDems and Blue Amp Action to help us organize voters in every corner of Wisconsin where Democrats have the chance to win?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T79287b13-68a2-4c08-ba23-29c19f72d6f9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: CAPT Hung Cao
subject: The long journey to America
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
| | | [](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=492ca39b35e5425c89badbd9c8204b86&_e=LcgnHyCUCGRUCPhIkljRyvHseDJhEtK5SnEKIUKp9JK7lJXGeLKiK9sRqhrrXkSXyQTPdyp9cCq9FI-fn-u4LFD2nxoS0NvfCfaAgDtvMGyzPas5mQjGUojj0npIeNLhFhPxOluTJUztLaCmdcBZmyOwwqcvkbvFjaO7Yq5oO2ck9uQ9DnmgxCLeZXNCchGcuctaNDUwIGVL0rZY_WKBVrGDq3M1kEWsWnMkJLVjnfyZfyPpK3u9Yml9-8xC7XSTjLJaFqfzeNrbp88ov6PJU6sW3e6NwNlfPrgckwX6Au2ppaRjiNIXRBzM25LqJGUEmbovqVJTDqU_zIKDhjlB8a598GJXLay5kLY0dP04QksFfn23TwzgW7j16GTxKybg)
---
| | Peter,
16 hours.

That’s the length of the plane ride from Vietnam to the island of Guam, a patch of American soil in the Pacific Ocean.

My family had escaped Communist Vietnam by the skin of our teeth, and we were on the way to a strange new place called America.

_But the second I stepped off that plane, I knew this country was different than the one I left._**
**
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=492ca39b35e5425c89badbd9c8204b86&_e=LcgnHyCUCGRUCPhIkljRyvHseDJhEtK5SnEKIUKp9JK7lJXGeLKiK9sRqhrrXkSXyQTPdyp9cCq9FI-fn-u4LFD2nxoS0NvfCfaAgDtvMGyzPas5mQjGUojj0npIeNLhFhPxOluTJUztLaCmdcBZmyOwwqcvkbvFjaO7Yq5oO2ck9uQ9DnmgxCLeZXNCchGcuctaNDUwIGVL0rZY_WKBVrGDq3M1kEWsWnMkJLVjnfx-TaB7wHRK6jngZJqMAZ1RGKdSTnau9nmReFhkjOmArTfsApsjTs-I8PHwgsHtXiP5MAKus_lW9x4NP8I-Vl4861z74HMcNGUZ3QZDYqlCmJIbwosGlFXJeF-gM9_YdU6nOU6d8qBl8ApLhi3IEnFp)
---
Here, people weren’t afraid. The streets were vibrant with laughter. In America, I knew we were truly free.

Despite coming to this country not knowing a word of English, I dedicated every second of my time learning how to become an American.

I knew I owed my life to this country, so at just 18 years old, I decided to dedicate my life to serving it. I was appointed to the U.S. Naval Academy, and after graduating, served as a Captain in the Navy for 25 years.
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=492ca39b35e5425c89badbd9c8204b86&_e=LcgnHyCUCGRUCPhIkljRyvHseDJhEtK5SnEKIUKp9JK7lJXGeLKiK9sRqhrrXkSXyQTPdyp9cCq9FI-fn-u4LFD2nxoS0NvfCfaAgDtvMGyzPas5mQjGUojj0npIeNLhFhPxOluTJUztLaCmdcBZmyOwwqcvkbvFjaO7Yq5oO2ck9uQ9DnmgxCLeZXNCchGcuctaNDUwIGVL0rZY_WKBVrGDq3M1kEWsWnMkJLVjnfxQSKzp11HdroFpMyNucZTnHQCdR3nU-MT1MDth2VTC1gztAbCjj-aGSJXwq5QMbsdn0jcnqkzb4pTD7pNuTloLLo6g7p4RjrdEP5zZWV30JhLDolIQIEU9XUik0LLisu70RtWDk9UE082HWwdR92Fj)
---
My years on the front lines of combat weren’t easy. There were many months away from my family. I pushed my body and my mind to the limit. There were times where I didn’t know if I’d get out alive.

_But it was worth it, because I was defending the country I loved and keeping the American Dream alive for my family._

Today, my service in the Navy may be over, but I’m not done fighting for our country.

**I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because Joe Biden is ERADICATING the same values that my fellow soldiers and I put our lives on the line for.**

I believe our families deserve better than failing and aging career politicians. _Our country deserves better._
---
[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=492ca39b35e5425c89badbd9c8204b86&_e=LcgnHyCUCGRUCPhIkljRyvHseDJhEtK5SnEKIUKp9JK7lJXGeLKiK9sRqhrrXkSXyQTPdyp9cCq9FI-fn-u4LFD2nxoS0NvfCfaAgDtvMGyzPas5mQjGUojj0npIeNLhFhPxOluTJUztLaCmdcBZmyOwwqcvkbvFjaO7Yq5oO2ck9uQ9DnmgxCLeZXNCchGcuctaNDUwIGVL0rZY_WKBVrGDq3M1kEWsWnMkJLVjnfwJpqbVijUrWwvLc5yAAjm4Y7mB9Ymh9U8ITNIaY5RBrLwUva5CsC6D-qtTHYOhaoS1NGI8vfT4Eq2uTWwr0zWTbuk1RbE_y0urFS7TP00ErUiSLlGzUNB_0wjmnLGdfbHBfMpzQ9iZ2-dzuNJI5hUd)

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, 16 hours. That’s the length of the plane ride from Vietnam to the island of Guam, a patch of American soil in the Pacific Ocean. My family had escaped Communist Vietnam by the skin of our teeth, and we were on the way to a strange new place called America. But the second I stepped off that plane, I knew this country was different than the one I left. Here, people weren’t afraid. The streets were vibrant with laughter. In America, I knew we were truly free. Despite coming to this country not knowing a word of English, I dedicated every second of my time learning how to become an American. I knew I owed my life to this country, so at just 18 years old, I decided to dedicate my life to serving it. I was appointed to the U.S. Naval Academy, and after graduating, served as a Captain in the Navy for 25 years. My years on the front lines of combat weren’t easy. There were many months away from my family. I pushed my body and my mind to the limit. There were times where I didn’t know if I’d get out alive. But it was worth it, because I was defending the country I loved and keeping the American Dream alive for my family. Today, my service in the Navy may be over, but I’m not done fighting for our country. I’m running for U.S. Senate in Virginia because Joe Biden is ERADICATING the same values that my fellow soldiers and I put our lives on the line for. I believe our families deserve better than failing and aging career politicians. Our country deserves better. I’ll never give up on the country that saved my life, and I hope you’ll join me in my mission to save America. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

subject: The battle for free speech is going to the Supreme Court
body:
Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk0nbdr88poktnlnhureco559du350d69nt9os0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chhm9o34chh2bs)
---
|

[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zu75f4ool2vf8t2trvc63sltcmtmb4jsupia101g_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chhm9o34chh2bs)
---
**One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven’t heard about it.** Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason — conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that’s not an exaggeration; we’ve experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person (“Admiral” Rachel Levine) as a man. It’s gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. **_That’s why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws._**
---
[Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zoi6bmo51bn7cgo4a03l7pkjsgc4e4n8o9q4ntc8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chhm9o34chh2bs)
---
This is nothing new for us. We’ve long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we’ve taken on over the years:
* We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page.
* We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech."
* We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery.
* We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers
* We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks

Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn’t easy or inexpensive, but it’s the right thing to do. And it’s making a difference. But we can’t do it without you. **[**Will you become a paid subscriber to The Babylon Bee to help us stay in the fight?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpvdhq9kgimfa086k81lekbrne29hkflm89shkj0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32chhm9o34chh2bs)**

name: Giffords.org
subject: Asking you to complete our April Gun Safety Priorities Survey
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
We first want to thank you so much for your incredible outpouring of support ahead of our FEC fundraising deadline. Because of the support of this community, we were able to meet our goals and can report strong numbers.
As we head into the next quarter, we’re ramping up our work to elect gun safety champions in this year’s elections and to help pass more gun violence prevention legislation—all with the goal to keep our communities safer from gun violence.
We’re always working to understand the gun safety priorities of supporters like you to help shape our electoral and legislative priorities.
That’s why today we’re asking: [**Will you please share your top gun safety priorities with us by taking our April Gun Safety Priorities Survey?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/apr24-priorities-sv-em/?source=em240403-1-30&refcode2=7891.3935704.QV9YIm&akid=7891%2E3935704%2EQV9YIm)
**[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://go.giffords.org/signup/apr24-priorities-sv-em/?source=em240403-1-30&refcode2=7891.3935704.QV9YIm&akid=7891%2E3935704%2EQV9YIm)**
We’re at a turning point in our movement. In the past two years, we’ve helped pass the most significant federal gun safety legislation in three decades, tightened background check loopholes, advocated for the creation of the first ever federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention, and have made landmark progress in states nationwide.
But make no mistake: we’re still in the midst of a gun violence crisis. The United States has more guns, weaker gun laws, and higher rates of gun violence than any other developed country in the world.
[**We depend on concerned folks like you sharing their gun safety priorities to help us shape our work. Will you please share your top gun safety priorities with us by taking our April Gun Safety Priorities Survey?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/apr24-priorities-sv-em/?source=em240403-1-30&refcode2=7891.3935704.QV9YIm&akid=7891%2E3935704%2EQV9YIm)
**[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://go.giffords.org/signup/apr24-priorities-sv-em/?source=em240403-1-30&refcode2=7891.3935704.QV9YIm&akid=7891%2E3935704%2EQV9YIm)**
We really value your input, so thank you for taking the time to share your priorities with us today.
\- The team at GIFFORDS

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=7891%2E3935704%2EQV9YIm) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

Fellow American, my name is Curtis Bashaw.

I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then.

I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years.

But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Fellow American. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods.

The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When you hired me as State Treasurer in 2020, I made a promise - now I’m ready to do it again as your next U.S. Representative for West Virginia Congressional District 2.

| [](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=015f3896c741485e8297f4c80257fd2e&_e=ndB4rZ-TfuZ97iED4PmYNJScEdocn_oPqJfMTDO5nz0cBs-p3n9iUvE89GAMwO6kSd6t7nF92THx949Y0iiGwyn0hWburtHnI438COlHSzfEo7ziu0do3fx7MvHJ9ASIY-qIgUlRg9kCHN-uoya-UmHXfLcTIElIM1kMsxy2nMNSC3xsXElbb_ZqOqrHfAxZJtSpCAU4FuAMHzwN-scAHqqUoMLr5D6z8DtbH4sXTOkgzR6T8C9qmnuGCrwcpVpc50JM2xdWDTP7-i7k3ejE1XI4xNvVTkokNcWnTOoH5m48dbwS3lKVU5TSKr6gxUgim4OVrQkaHzUFlwMOUSnD4fLbDSO0vTOzAqMDPbOwnu33zUywy_ztYEVClxNrbDV77fJ0yLNGbPFlWrMaWHc0ig%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American,

I made a promise when you hired me as State Treasurer four years ago. As the next U.S. Representative for West Virginia’s 2nd Congressional District (God willing), I’m ready to do it again.

I promised you that I would get to work for all West Virginians and deliver on our shared goals; goals that will take our state from good to great, and make it the best place for people to live, work, and raise their families.

As I run for a new office, I promise to continue pushing West Virginia to be the best it can be. I’m prepared to fight for you by working to:

* Decrease inflation and put hard-earned dollars back into the pockets of Americans

* Invest in our teachers and children so the next generation can reach their full potential (no more CRT curriculum in schools)

* Put our economy back on track & get folks back to work

* Secure our border to STOP the drugs, crime, and human trafficking poisoning our communities

* Support law enforcement and our military, who work to keep us safe at home and overseas

| [**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=015f3896c741485e8297f4c80257fd2e&_e=ndB4rZ-TfuZ97iED4PmYNJScEdocn_oPqJfMTDO5nz0cBs-p3n9iUvE89GAMwO6kSd6t7nF92THx949Y0iiGwyn0hWburtHnI438COlHSzfEo7ziu0do3fx7MvHJ9ASIY-qIgUlRg9kCHN-uoya-UmHXfLcTIElIM1kMsxy2nMNSC3xsXElbb_ZqOqrHfAxZqgPjkoPSEQeMrSePUszzVyMIWLrqJ8MKjMwac1j4zMS3oxWFoRgzOV10WHFxrD6kKORZCqYUcgUKz33f_F1MIku1y-5R4sZW_cpxPjUAmc73__Yb-XvaScyGkhDNeL3FFb7IEBtkmpH-pGPzvh7m82X4aZa-b8jIHqeIG2MSjsaqDaqCsAcIMfVG_QSb9E68Vd4BxkCARlovLMMU64-4YQ%3D%3D)
---

We can do all of this together, not because of partisan views, but because we know these common sense solutions will deliver the best results for all of West Virginia and America.

All of these shared goals are at risk from the far Left Democrats who are trying to take control of the House, Senate, and White House in 2024. They are trying to lead West Virginia and America down a path toward higher taxes, higher crime, higher inflation, unsafe communities, and fewer jobs.

As your next Congressman, I refuse to let that happen. I’m not going to stand by and let them steal your paychecks and raise your taxes to fund their bogus plans. I’m not going to let our border remain wide open and crime flood into our communities. I’m not going to let them take jobs out of West Virginia.

I promise to find common-sense solutions to defend West Virginia and prevent the Left from tearing apart the American Dream even further. I appreciate your support as I aim to deliver on these promises.

[**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=015f3896c741485e8297f4c80257fd2e&_e=ndB4rZ-TfuZ97iED4PmYNJScEdocn_oPqJfMTDO5nz0cBs-p3n9iUvE89GAMwO6kSd6t7nF92THx949Y0iiGwyn0hWburtHnI438COlHSzfEo7ziu0do3fx7MvHJ9ASIY-qIgUlRg9kCHN-uoya-UmHXfLcTIElIM1kMsxy2nMNSC3xsXElbb_ZqOqrHfAxZqgPjkoPSEQeMrSePUszzVyMIWLrqJ8MKjMwac1j4zMQmjjRt4aeTFR-DfoIuc2GLAPwNZ9w3XJNtfMM7bn0ORXwUVmVRw82RtfNbLF7ijwSrgGpKm6dPj3RzZG9WHtGzjUJdbiK5PKYplYbFZf4M24Kdgk1b5nGOOSFF74CiPuMMEiNf9_odXJhdyX3RDHAsn_FNjzy4jRnbWG7oWP9vuQ%3D%3D)

Thank you for your support,

Riley Moore

body:
Dahlstrom named "standout candidate" by top Republican campaign arm | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/nancyforalaska/ak-al-moves-towards-republicans-after-lt-governor-nancy-dahlstroms-entrance-into-the-race-10288365?e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=8f5c46a42d&e=a20d8ad2ed)
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: [press@nancyforalaska.com](mailto:press@nancyforalaska.com)
**Breaking: Congressional Leadership Fund Endorses Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom** _Dahlstrom named "standout candidate" by top Republican campaign arm_
**Anchorage, AK** \- Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom [earned](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=5eafbe1276&e=a20d8ad2ed) the endorsement of Congressional Leadership Fund (CLF), a top Republican campaign apparatus that will invest heavily to advance the conservative agenda and expand the House majority this cycle.
Dahlstrom was one of twenty congressional challengers included in the “Trailblazers” program who will receive financial support from the group as a high-priority congressional target. In 2022, CLF spent $250 million to secure the House majority in target congressional seats.
Dan Conston, CLF’s President, stated, **“These candidates have proven they have what it takes to connect with voters and win in battleground districts”** and noted that the carefully picked endorsements are led by **"standout candidates with proven track records of tangible achievement and impressive character."**
CLF joins a growing list of high-level Republicans backing Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom including Alaska Governor Mike Dunleavy, Speaker Mike Johnson, Leader Steve Scalise, Whip Tom Emmer, and Chairwoman Elise Stefanik. The key endorsements signal that Dahlstrom will be a formidable force as the only candidate that can beat incumbent Mary Peltola.
**“I am thrilled to have the backing of Congressional Leadership Fund and to be included in their Trailblazers program,”** stated Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom. **“Alaska needs new leadership in Washington to actually fight for our priorities and I’m proud to be trusted by top officials to be that person to fight for our state and lead us into the future.”**
_Nancy Dahlstrom currently serves as the Lt. Governor for the state of Alaska. Nancy was first appointed to serve as a State Representative in 2003 and then served as a Senior Advisor for Military Affairs. In 2018, Nancy took on the role to serve as the Commissioner of Corrections and was a leader in cracking down on crime and ensuring criminals serve their time. As Lieutenant Governor, Nancy has prioritized public safety, energy security, and emergency preparedness._

I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri. It was one of those places where the curbs crumbled into the streets and the sidewalks were so tilted you couldn’t really walk on them — though they made a pretty good bike ramp for all of us kids.
We all ran in and out of each other’s houses, everyone’s parents took care of everyone. **It was a magical place to live.**
Like so many families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck — and when my littlest sister was born with a heart condition, we were bankrupted by medical bills.
Our family got by thanks to the generosity of our community — most people had no more money than we did, but helped us anyway. Our neighbors and friends took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, they brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
Their support helped me go to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up.

Look, big change starts small.
That's a lesson that my grandmother, Polly Noonan, first taught me decades ago. Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany.
By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. **She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can.**
For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. That's how Democrats defeated the odds in 2022 to defend and even expand our Senate majority. And that's why I know that we can win again in 2024.
With Democrats defending 23 seats, the odds are certainly stacked against us. And after the 2022 red wave in New York, Republicans here are already targeting my seat for defeat. **But when people like you get off the sidelines and chip in even just $3, eventually we'll build a grassroots movement capable of defeating even the GOP's wealthiest megadonors.**
**[So please, will you chip in $3 or $25 or whatever you can spare today to help save our Senate majority by building a grassroots movement one grassroots gift at a time? body:
It is an honor to be in this fight with you
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1064%2E791427%2EFtdu-4)

Hi friend, I wanted you to hear the news from me: [**I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-april24-ayanna-split.-irD_S&refcode=em240403-1-t2&t=2&akid=1064%2E791427%2EFtdu-4)**
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong -- we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything.
Together, our A-Team has...
* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding -- to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from peacefully protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.

**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted inhumanity and love -- but only if we keep fighting. **
[**So friend, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $3 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Ilhan's. We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank you.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-april24-ayanna-split.-irD_S&refcode=em240403-1-t2&t=3&akid=1064%2E791427%2EFtdu-4)**

That means you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his _ActBlue_ allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, D.C. **[That why I'm humbly asking you to rush and emergency $35 contribution to my campaign today.](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=be1fe828598845c08cf3b7f7c4b62470&_e=1oZ76l1dL4NrmYR5i-DsTOncVjDkqIAI7Dmjgczg8v8MiqwACkHNGNtG4q_a4qoyXZtStF5UKuR2hXfBwk1WEq8hfeOSIj1TjTxQLeAgQNgFCUSSrfauVE4OtrD02YONXDs6bELLXSNi-pvYCBdTJxSMSkKCVXpeY7zQJxAzjCkxCeaEEKnAXoWM7a2abCPuMzqruCNuIgmnU0Q3MF3sGW98IkvHw9kbkmxP892kgwWOH_MVMbt25agh9SbXENMcm2ZIzMCp3EjVM8zY0fUy0xvfBeATrhPy0DWDP7h97kn9Y8S4KNGIvKeBeGEio8pQTxmPnEiPqaay4fh7cY2kxWdR17Uc4xfJnGuqOaAnO0aLRLenFxWfGOAidW8v-ckmy_H5VtWu1STesn8EUxVYgA%3D%3D)** There's no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it's so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember? ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember? ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember?? Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. Fellow American, my name is Curtis Bashaw.

I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then.

I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years.

But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Fellow American. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods.

The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, _**we were ignored.**_

**As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican.** [**But now I’ve decided to stand up and do something about it. I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=fa01a179a70a44a2a24f24b79fde8301&_e=Dtdgag2Fp_L95BNhMaOFhhl4JB7NEO2vxcUo8Fkit_VHFrTOWpyc486_rkeHLN74ZICw5J1IXF29fOWI6lUQ1anm0-kMiH8l2JL3Yv8QvGyny0r7Lpis70R5pz5cXYH6sop1sBLp_-e3pvorFgHJFMTEWfXfyO11ZKpSDcwEwdFIi1ixvKfJKC9F9_BYQ_GxhiGi_4-xwTj5e4F_oeDvwCcsuequHQxBP21jLpC_KnnPlBg5aq5HxQVXT40QAcaoPaZvPuwwURIIQFYau4PWzbDnvmGjkwWVPRt0JTZNXlWUvE4t9W43Pt9wxFNjWwbVNWdZt1GG6velgmHNQdBWJfbm-S3FgRQDtOpRkLjWQ-4RObg6YaneMZZ0QhRkRmaNG-oSwbmGuFpxZa-j6VRo9f73zjMa6hWMWN6HJKl0PTE%3D)

[**I believe we can’t keep sending the same corrupt politicians to Washington and expecting different results. I believe New Jersey and Americans deserve better than the political machine that has ruled for far too long.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=fa01a179a70a44a2a24f24b79fde8301&_e=Dtdgag2Fp_L95BNhMaOFhhl4JB7NEO2vxcUo8Fkit_VHFrTOWpyc486_rkeHLN74ZICw5J1IXF29fOWI6lUQ1anm0-kMiH8l2JL3Yv8QvGyny0r7Lpis70R5pz5cXYH6sop1sBLp_-e3pvorFgHJFMTEWfXfyO11ZKpSDcwEwdFIi1ixvKfJKC9F9_BYQ_GxhiGi_4-xwTj5e4F_oeDvwCcsuequHQxBP21jLpC_KnnPlBg5aq5HxQVXT40QAcaoPaZvPuwwURIIQFYau4PWzSa6Gz9xsG8FLMYcdGl0kPHDwcG0yNM9UTkhMYnNXTbGiiYXebd8aIPeIk1FFR3inVvtWT2QJYFPUt-zr_kxsZFYAR1YpQpopzpC7g4yvVt4BU9wn3OmtgrIb8-fc18yQkB2Y54rLx2JvK9f0Y1oNfI%3D)

[** ****SEND CURTIS BASHAW TO WASHINGTON » **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=fa01a179a70a44a2a24f24b79fde8301&_e=Dtdgag2Fp_L95BNhMaOFhhl4JB7NEO2vxcUo8Fkit_VHFrTOWpyc486_rkeHLN74ZICw5J1IXF29fOWI6lUQ1anm0-kMiH8l2JL3Yv8QvGyny0r7Lpis70R5pz5cXYH6sop1sBLp_-e3pvorFgHJFMTEWfXfyO11ZKpSDcwEwdFIi1ixvKfJKC9F9_BYQ_GxhiGi_4-xwTj5e4F_oeDvwCcsuequHQxBP21jLpC_KnnPlBg5aq5HxQVXT40QAcaoPaZvPuwwURIIQFYau4PWzbkZQpV79l6eOCGmjxubsqmdXGVfEnMCil3hNyndmRQoH2RYaS_8P_nbaf0G2fnWNQ_eIPSIoaWssoKg_V3oaZOoXiaRtoQEbecNo2rjxT4i7j-fe0evTRXHhwyr7qQlLnJ7jZHozBDbKpTQ1pXoEU4%3D)

Fellow American, like you, I’m fed up with Washington's dysfunction. [**I’m a political outsider on a mission to fix it.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=fa01a179a70a44a2a24f24b79fde8301&_e=Dtdgag2Fp_L95BNhMaOFhhl4JB7NEO2vxcUo8Fkit_VHFrTOWpyc486_rkeHLN74ZICw5J1IXF29fOWI6lUQ1anm0-kMiH8l2JL3Yv8QvGyny0r7Lpis70R5pz5cXYH6sop1sBLp_-e3pvorFgHJFMTEWfXfyO11ZKpSDcwEwdFIi1ixvKfJKC9F9_BYQ_GxhiGi_4-xwTj5e4F_oeDvwCcsuequHQxBP21jLpC_KnnPlBg5aq5HxQVXT40QAcaoPaZvPuwwURIIQFYau4PWzW0yDsaMHQHesAdkI9eNvwqQHI_vSFfVnO5nPOmgChj7o5dCDT750Nmj2wgwTHxV8iWPzdGLZKT19O_ytLVmo2jW6kBWqXdl2CNvv8xUma_5ThRH0lZ3mJwuVVCXHrajpWklTrLagBTPowbfNoiHoSc%3D)

America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job.

Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government.

Our families cannot afford to elect another selfish, so-called _"leader"_ who cares more about their own political ambitions than coming up with sensible solutions that actually help law-abiding American citizens. **_We deserve better than this._**

I am running for the United States Senate because I believe we need to restore freedom, security, and opportunity for all Americans. I am running to restore the American dream. name: Riley Gaines
subject: BREAKING NEWS: Police suspend my assault case
body:
The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended

| Fellow Conservative, At San Francisco State University last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours. I’m still waiting for justice. **The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco State University police - with no charges filed. The officer who replied to my inquiry said, “The charges in this case are unfounded.”** This just encourages what happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don’t see this happen to so-called “progressive” speakers, or to anyone who dissents from my viewpoint. While I was locked in the classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on social media, **“When they want you silent, speak louder.”** I am more determined than ever to keep speaking louder. [That’s exactly what my team and I do here at the Leadership Institute.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32607%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=caNHfsyZ8hKnfRSAPU0E3Q&sysid=1)__ Through the **Riley Gaines Center** at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. We travel the country to spread the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and women to share their stories and protect themselves against radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality - and the very concept of truth itself. Women fought for equality. Now our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to dissent.
That’s why my colleagues and I show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people become principled leaders on their campuses and in their communities - and fight for America’s future. [I’d love to have you join this movement to defend women, sanity, and free speech.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32608%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uLp%2fHMFidswQvYlM%2bo1BOw&sysid=1)**** Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center
at the Leadership Institute

| | **For Immediate Release:** March 3, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC Backs Dave Min for Congress**
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC, comprising nearly 100 House members and one Senator known for championing transformative policies in Washington, has officially endorsed Senator Dave Min for Congress. This endorsement highlights Min's commitment to an inclusive economy, drawing on his rich background in public service, from combating corporate fraud at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to shaping future legal minds as a law professor at UC Irvine.

**"The Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC is proud to endorse Dave Min for Congress. His unwavering commitment to reproductive rights, his courageous stand against the gun lobby, and his forward-thinking on climate action are precisely the qualities we desperately need in Congress,”** said CPC PAC Co-Chairs Pramila Jayapal, Mark Pocan, and Jamie Raskin.**“During his time in California’s State Senate, Dave has crafted legislation that speaks to the heart of what it means to fight for a fairer, more equitable society – prioritizing working Americans over corporate interests, fighting economic and social inequality, and advancing civil liberties.”**

As a California State Senator, Dave distinguished himself as a staunch advocate for progressive values, demonstrated through his championing of abortion rights via Proposition 1 and his uncompromising stance on gun safety, which earned him an 'F' rating from the NRA. His legislative efforts to halt offshore drilling and push for the decarbonization of significant sectors, coupled with his initiatives to hold corporations accountable for climate risk, have established him as a pivotal figure in the environmental movement. Beyond these achievements, Dave's commitment to upholding the rule of law, his active stance against voter suppression, and his advocacy for a modernized educational system that adapts to economic shifts, all underline his capability and readiness to address some of the most critical challenges facing our society today with both pragmatic and innovative approaches.

**"I am deeply honored to receive the endorsement of the Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC,”** said Dave Min.**“This endorsement reaffirms my commitment to fighting for progressive change and working tirelessly to build a more equitable and just society. In Congress, I will continue to advocate for policies that uplift every American and address the critical challenges facing our nation."**

A Harvard Law School graduate, Min's career has been defined by his choice to combat corporate fraud at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) following significant accounting scandals, rather than pursuing more lucrative private sector opportunities. His advocacy for economic fairness continued on Capitol Hill as an economic policy director, particularly during the mortgage crisis, further solidifying his commitment to justice and equity. Min's commitment to economic equity and justice continued as he served as an economic policy director on Capitol Hill, notably during the critical times of the mortgage crisis, before returning to California to contribute to the academic foundation of UC Irvine's then-new law school. ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

TAMPA, Fla. – A Florida Congressional candidate is condemning the city of Tampa for hosting an Islamic iftar dinner celebrating Ramadan, a month... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/448ac476be39/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13693289?e=00028e5542)
