[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=f4634f0c0e&e=00028e5542)
[**Congressional Candidate blasts City of Tampa, mayor for hosting Islamic dinner after Florida imam calls for genocide of Jews**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=c18fb4d540&e=00028e5542)
_Florida Congressional candidate James Judge (R-FL) condemned the mayor of Tampa and city officials for using taxpayer resources to host a Ramadan iftar on Tuesday, just weeks after a Florida imam called for the annihilation of Israel._
_***Images can be found here:_[_https://judgeforcongress.com/congressional-candidate-blasts-city-of-tampa-mayor-for-hosting-islamic-dinner-after-florida-imam-calls-for-genocide-of-jews/_](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=7540c9b0d8&e=00028e5542)_***_

TAMPA, Fla. – A Florida Congressional candidate is condemning the city of Tampa for hosting an Islamic iftar dinner celebrating Ramadan, a month considered holy to Muslims, after a Florida Imam openly called for the genocide of Jews and prayed for Islamic jihadists at a Florida mosque in March.
“The outrageousness here is twofold,” said Judge. “Not only is the lesbian mayor of Tampa celebrating Ramadan with people whose cousins back home would chop her head off for being gay, but she’s doing so on city property, using taxpayer resources. The city of Tampa didn’t celebrate Easter last week. It won’t celebrate Passover later this month. But since Ramadan scores Mayor Castor points with the pro-suicide bomber diversity crowd, she finds it appropriate to use taxpayer dollars to host it on city property.”
The Second Annual Mayor’s Iftar was hosted at City Center by Mayor Jane Castor in her official capacity as mayor at the government-owned venue, while Tampa’s city hall was proudly illuminated green to show support for Islam. Following the evening, the mayor took to social media to post photos from the event.
“Tonight we hosted our 2nd Annual Mayor’s Iftar honoring Ramadan & celebrating our city’s diversity,” one of the photos from Castor’s post said. The City of Tampa’s official social media page also shared the post.
That’s when Tampa small business owner and U.S. Congressional candidate James Judge criticized the absurdity of the mayor’s and city’s actions.
“This is pure foolishness,” Judge said on Facebook in response to the post. “The LGBTQ+ mayor of Tampa is openly celebrating Ramadan. She would literally face public execution for her lifestyle if she lived in most countries that celebrate Ramadan. Instead, she uses her official office and city resources to promote a religion which preaches hate towards Christians and Jews and is dedicated to the destruction of Israel.”
Shortly thereafter, the Facebook post was deleted, but remained live on the city’s Instagram stories. Then, in a surprising reversal, the mayor and City of Tampa reshared the images shortly after 9 a.m. Wednesday.
According to Judge, government resources should not be used to promote fundamental Islam, which he says is an increasingly dangerous threat facing the world, particularly in the United States, referencing a [video where Dr. Fadi Yousef Kablawi, an imam in North Miami openly called for the genocide of Jews on March 8](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=d37e3b880d&e=00028e5542).
[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=25f828e59a&e=00028e5542)
Calls for jihad and genocide are not isolated incidents within fundamental Islam. Just months prior, [a Michigan Imam called for jihad against the west in a social media post on X](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5484eb6463&e=00028e5542), the platform formerly known as Twitter.
James Judge is running for Congress in Florida’s 12th Congressional District against incumbent Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL). He was born and raised in the Tampa Bay area and runs his business in the city of Tampa.
[About James Judge](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=a29cf417cf&e=00028e5542):
James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Dade City, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.

_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

Friend,

When you hired me two years ago, I made a promise.

I promised that I would go to work for all Virginians and deliver on a shared vision that takes our great Commonwealth forward to become the best place to live, work, and raise a family.

Together, we have climbed closer and closer to that goal... to that shining city on a hill where we know Virginia should be:

We delivered $5 billion in tax relief, because your hard-earned money belongs to you and not the government.

We made record investments in our students and our teachers, so Virginia's next generation can realize their full potential with a best-in-class education.

We put parents back at the head seat of the table in their children's lives, because that's where parents belong.

We started to transform our behavioral health system to get Virginians struggling with mental health challenges the right help, right now.

We backed our law enforcement heroes with pay raises and the resources they need to keep us safe. | [ **STAND WITH GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN** ](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=afff15471fc745029d4bc2fe950cbd83&_e=5rF2w-GcQwSUF8VGQIa3m9cctEbv9AAdCR9zW4NU3e85iwPGg7Lh5JWV5UWdOG9YLpJQgmIt04XKyXzm5F9li9t5z_u69iZODw61_i75puHxERUHGG5GezvhD5BWrePohDeBS9-jsB5FSIG41eIlIq7896bscIOmRMyW0QhUb2Mdr4U7Llu7qLTBwJ_EtoWhizEtkDPkDzincHlDQ2viHSXtFTy4zLya_VsS1S74ujccNXEuILA9YPXx55cQbH0O0Ki-kgGVMe4GqLyFXPQI9c0nfxnTxqmD3M62-tBhKQIsZFdPmhQJMjEZmOgTKYu5BDpbhtKms9b2WIweKOt0cT0U-HK8OLPZAwGZ6qo74mwD4ZTwPIuWqkASg5da1tSYW6OYMAFQx_EBZaLsuYBWJA%3D%3D)

We did all of this, together, not based on a partisan agenda but because we know that commonsense solutions deliver the best results for Virginia.

But all that progress threatens to be undone by far-left Democrats who barely control our General Assembly. They are trying to lead Virginia down a path toward higher taxes, fewer jobs, unsafe communities, and a stagnant economy.

As your Governor, I am not going to let that happen. I am not going to let them steal from your paychecks and raise your taxes. I am not going to let them put violent criminals back on our streets. I am not going to let them drive economic opportunity and jobs away from the Commonwealth.

I was elected to find commonsense solutions to propel Virginia forward. I promise to use my veto pen to protect Virginians from taxation and bad policies, and I appreciate your support as I deliver on the promise I made when you hired me.

clean_body: | Friend, When you hired me two years ago, I made a promise. I promised that I would go to work for all Virginians and deliver on a shared vision that takes our great Commonwealth forward to become the best place to live, work, and raise a family. Together, we have climbed closer and closer to that goal... to that shining city on a hill where we know Virginia should be: We delivered $5 billion in tax relief, because your hard-earned money belongs to you and not the government. We made record investments in our students and our teachers, so Virginia's next generation can realize their full potential with a best-in-class education. We put parents back at the head seat of the table in their children's lives, because that's where parents belong. We started to transform our behavioral health system to get Virginians struggling with mental health challenges the right help, right now. We backed our law enforcement heroes with pay raises and the resources they need to keep us safe. | We did all of this, together, not based on a partisan agenda but because we know that commonsense solutions deliver the best results for Virginia. But all that progress threatens to be undone by far-left Democrats who barely control our General Assembly. They are trying to lead Virginia down a path toward higher taxes, fewer jobs, unsafe communities, and a stagnant economy. As your Governor, I am not going to let that happen. I am not going to let them steal from your paychecks and raise your taxes. I am not going to let them put violent criminals back on our streets. I am not going to let them drive economic opportunity and jobs away from the Commonwealth. I was elected to find commonsense solutions to propel Virginia forward. I promise to use my veto pen to protect Virginians from taxation and bad policies, and I appreciate your support as I deliver on the promise I made when you hired me. Thank you for your continued support. Governor Glenn Youngkin Contributions to Spirit of Virginia are not deductible for tax purposes as charitable contributions. | Promises Made, Promises Kept. body:
Pennsylvania is a critical battleground state, and the outcome of this election will have far-reaching consequences for the future of our democracy and the rights we rely upon.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82285302/464908019/-235138187?refcode=em24_240403_pfd3_fnd_gq_act___js_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240403_pfd3_fnd_gq_act___js_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=18326&refcode2=2215dda4-daf1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjE1ZGRhNC1kYWYxLWVlMTEtYWFmMi0wMDIyNDgyMjMzNTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8ENPRZpFY9C-YlcZP80PO3RshVtPgXk1s9RTXAG_SBc=) Peter,

Pennsylvania is a critical battleground state, and the outcome of this election will have far-reaching consequences for the future of our democracy and the rights we rely upon. **That's why it's crucial that we rally behind strong, dedicated leaders like Matt Cartwright.**

All Republicans, and all voters and citizens, can join us in for our FREE community town halls across the state.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Fellow American, my name is Curtis Bashaw.

I’m a lifelong New Jersey resident. In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. And I’ve been working nonstop since then.

I started a business and I’m a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people. It’s never been easy, but it’s always been worth it.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks and know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me effectively doing my job. And I’ve been successfully doing that for 35 years.

But the pandemic changed our business and our American way of life, Fellow American. Working in the tourism and hospitality industry, I saw firsthand how quickly the government can take away our freedoms - our livelihoods.

The entire industry was shut down. We lost most of our income and there was no end in sight. Hundreds of small businesses and families stood on the brink of financial disaster. When the business community and government leaders in the county wrote a plan and demanded the Governor to let us reopen, _**we were ignored.**_

**As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican.** [**But now I’ve decided to stand up and do something about it. I’m proudly running for the United States Senate because I believe more government equals less freedom.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=cb251de2c9b6479ca8dc98483738f781&_e=Pn1hmLmRDHku4ZYrgc1lDjl-xB7qbX0T4V-oO4-f5f8qoVt8nz86oBcBZtcygr_qRpNhTyA1CDsrC__OIL2QnvHziPXkuWhxuodZLQ-X0Qs_f_ZvTEJ8pPp2Fl9VZNwMm78OvFiKL7A7HqHfNMjv7y_CXSRynHDmmqW57Jz3pFXi27JKL1mF8S85oCdyUQyMP3FOSDLxkEcu3bqoaj551r-2zJi9EydfqtyJgnaxiEuM00CO1azQdEvwSagcVFiwwl2GfOcc-spy1KCTssFf-imq3MifAxw3_gNB4oAs-hzc-vghg882pVF5WtWA-sJnH3aol2RoDcF9lLaCFJBfO-W1dTdVX_ME_khWdyCzlEVX7mKX0CT6JB8VieQ4u-l_0W19dKCTbxD_wLnrA--a5zjjADkTbnKzKMcXOiBn5dg%3D)

America is the land of opportunity, and that starts with a strong economy. The best social program is a job.

Yet too many families are struggling to pay their mortgages, buy groceries, and put gas in their cars. In New Jersey, we pay the highest taxes in the nation yet receive only 75 cents back on the dollar from the federal government.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

name: Ayanna Pressley
subject: A big announcement from me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hi Peter, I wanted you to hear the
news from me: [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240403-ap.IRvRB1&refcode=em20240403-34119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34119%2E1203867%2EaEjBYY ]I’m officially running for re-election to represent
Massachusetts’ 7th District.

When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing
would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer
and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in
2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together.
“What has changed” they ask? Everything.

Together, our A-Team has...

* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris
administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been
canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting
for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more
affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college
programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when
conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in
our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from protesting on the steps of
the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during
COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and
return hostages in Gaza.

This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain
are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN
continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily
autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are
rooted in humanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240403-ap.IRvRB1&refcode=em20240403-34119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34119%2E1203867%2EaEjBYY ]So Peter, I’m asking you to
invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $5 or
anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Justice Democrats.
We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will
ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank
you.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240403-ap.IRvRB1&refcode=em20240403-34119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=34119%2E1203867%2EaEjBYY ]Contribute $5

Six years ago, this team elected the first Black woman and first person of
color to represent Massachusetts in Congress — but this movement is about
so much more than that.

I told this team that if you sent me to Washington, I wasn’t going alone.
I was bringing all of you with me. You all are my teachers, my partners,
and my accomplices. The issues that you care about are the issues I fight
for.

By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of
every person who has been left out and left behind.

You are sending a message that corporate interests should never win over
working people.

You’re affirming that abortion is health care.

That a college education should move us forward, not set us back.

That Black men deserve to grow old.

That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether
they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti.

That this movement is STRONG.

I love the Massachusetts 7th district.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240403-ap.IRvRB1&refcode=em20240403-34119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=34119%2E1203867%2EaEjBYY ]It is an honor to represent the people of the Massachusetts 7th, and
this movement, in Congress. If you can, please split a donation of
$5 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign
and Justice Democrats during this important moment.

Your Congresswoman,

Ayanna

This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted in humanity and love — but only if we keep fighting. [ ]So Peter, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $5 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Justice Democrats. We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank you. I told this team that if you sent me to Washington, I wasn’t going alone. I was bringing all of you with me. You all are my teachers, my partners, and my accomplices. The issues that you care about are the issues I fight for. By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of every person who has been left out and left behind. That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti. That this movement is STRONG. I love the Massachusetts 7th district. body:
It was never going to stop with Roe v. Wade The “Alliance Defending Freedom” (ADF) right-wing special interest group, notorious for its role in overturning _Roe v. Wade,_ is once again at the forefront of another alarming anti-freedom, anti-choice effort.

**This time, they are challenging the FDA's regulation over mifepristone, a safe and widely-used abortion pill. And soon, the Supreme Court will decide whether or not they’ll protect access to this life-saving medication.**

The ADF is trying to use an outdated 19th-century law to bypass medical expertise and restrict access to crucial healthcare services, including medication abortions._But I want to be clear about something:_ **This isn't just about FDA regulations; it's a calculated attack on reproductive rights across the nation.**

Personal decisions about reproductive health should be made between individuals and their doctors, not dictated by a vocal minority of extremists. When elected to Congress, I’ll remain a proud pro-choice leader and a strong voice for the majority of Americans, _which includes most St. Louisans_ , who understand that reproductive care IS healthcare.

When elected to Congress, I’ll ALWAYS vote to protect reproductive freedom. But if we’re going to build a winning campaign and take back the House majority in November, we’ll need all hands on deck. clean_body: It was never going to stop with Roe v. Wade The “Alliance Defending Freedom” (ADF) right-wing special interest group, notorious for its role in overturning Roe v. Wade, is once again at the forefront of another alarming anti-freedom, anti-choice effort. This time, they are challenging the FDA's regulation over mifepristone, a safe and widely-used abortion pill. And soon, the Supreme Court will decide whether or not they’ll protect access to this life-saving medication. The ADF is trying to use an outdated 19th-century law to bypass medical expertise and restrict access to crucial healthcare services, including medication abortions.But I want to be clear about something: This isn't just about FDA regulations; it's a calculated attack on reproductive rights across the nation. Personal decisions about reproductive health should be made between individuals and their doctors, not dictated by a vocal minority of extremists. When elected to Congress, I’ll remain a proud pro-choice leader and a strong voice for the majority of Americans, which includes most St. Louisans , who understand that reproductive care IS healthcare. When elected to Congress, I’ll ALWAYS vote to protect reproductive freedom. Friend, I’m committed to the fight for economic justice, including expanding workers’ rights. In partnership with workers, I recently created and introduced a bill to ensure musicians get compensated more fairly by major streaming services, which too often take advantage of artists’ labor. **While making record profits, streaming services and record labels aren’t sharing that prosperity with the artists who make the music we love.** Streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music pay artists fractions of a penny per stream, which isn’t nearly enough to make ends meet. **To change this disparity, Rep. Jamaal Bowman and I introduced the**** _Living Wage for Musicians Act_****.** If passed, this bill will directly compensate musicians with a fairer royalty payment of at least a penny per stream every time people listen to their music on a streaming music service like Spotify. By creating a fund that directly compensates recording artists and musicians, this legislation will allow so many more artists to achieve a living wage from music and be able to pay their bills. It will reform the music industry by supporting more diverse and independent artists, and inject more money into local economies. [**Can you sign on today to become a grassroots co-sponsor of our new bill, the**** _Living Wage for Musicians Act_****? Friend,
Detroit is one of the music capitals of the world, the birthplace of Motown and techno and so much more music that has changed our culture. **My city and my district are home to thousands of musicians and artists who deserve fair compensation for their labor.**
Across the country, musicians and artists are struggling to make ends meet while streaming services and record labels are seeing record profits.
Currently, Spotify pays artists an average per-stream royalty of $0.003, which means it takes artists more than 800,000 monthly streams to equal a full-time $15/hour job.
**As part of our push for economic justice, Rep. Jamaal Bowman and I introduced new legislation to ensure streaming services compensate musicians more fairly—creating a new fund that would aim to pay artists at least one penny per stream.**
In partnership with United Musicians and Allied Workers and local and national artists, we created the _Living Wage for Musicians Act_ to help more artists achieve a living wage from music, enabling them to pay rent, raise a family, buy a home, and invest in their future—including by making more music and touring.

It’s only right that the people who create the music we love get their fair share, so that they can thrive, not just survive.
Throughout my life I’ve joined striking workers on countless picket lines, and I know that workers’ rights change lives. When my father joined a union, our family was able to get healthcare for the first time.
We all deserve to make a wage that truly values the work we put in for ourselves and our families.

Here’s how social media misinformation machines reacted to Baltimore’s bridge collapse.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82292463/464922412/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDQyYmExNzQtZTNmMS1lZTExLWFhZjItMDAyMjQ4MjIzMzUzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qKVm13iGjBnKWo7pPt2ueQIn5QmhLF9ZrdTii2-4fXg=&emci=7e85a66e-e3f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=042ba174-e3f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=14016711)
Peter,

body:
Here’s a rundown of some of our biggest wins last night! | | | | |
---
Tuesday night delivered a bunch of big-wins for conservatives in southeastern Wisconsin!
Here’s a rundown of some of our biggest wins last night!
**Goodbye to Zuckerbucks in Wisconsin** Wisconsin voters _overwhelmingly approved_ Constitutional Amendment Questions 1 and 2.
By approving these amendments, we’ve banned private money and political operatives from influencing future elections in Wisconsin.
[I was glad to help get-out-the-vote with my friend Jim Jordan.](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=9b411f859d&e=e907534017)
This was a big win for election integrity in Wisconsin.
**Conservative Judges Elected** Local races are extremely important. That’s why we worked hard to elect conservative judges to the Circuit Court in:
* Kenosha County
* Racine County
* Walworth County

These judges will keep our communities safe. Our communities will be stronger and more secure because of their work.
**Kenosha Keeps Moving Right** Over the past 6 years Kenosha County has trended to the right. This is a testament to the hard work of our great volunteers getting the message out.
Our hard work is paying off.
Last night, _**Kenosha County elected a conservative Circuit Court Judge and a pro law-enforcement Mayor**_.
We’ve been consistently showing up in Kenosha and bringing our conservative message directly to voters.
And it’s working. But there’s no slowing down now.
We’re going to continue to show up, explain why our policies will move the country forward, and continue moving Kenosha to the right.
**Our Focus Moves to November** We need to build off the success we had last night as we prepare for the general election in November. This will be our best opportunity to keep our House majority, take back the Senate, and win the Presidency.
The November election runs through Wisconsin. And it runs through the First Congressional District.
I’ve been a top target of National Democrats.
That’s why dark money groups have spent more than **$2.2 million** **against me** on Milwaukee TV.
It’s why they spent **more money attacking me than any other Republican in Congress** last year.
I’m going to need to ask for your help this year.
If you’re willing and able, **donating to my campaign** will help me fight back against the attack ads they’re running against me.
[**Click Here to Donate $1, $5, or $10**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=3c8799d009&e=e907534017)
If you’d like to join our team on the ground, we’re always looking for more additions to Team Steil.
[**Click this link to join Team Steil!**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=0a73961b23&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

name: Hill Harper
subject: An important email about the Supreme Court and access to critical medical care. I hope you take a moment to read it.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
I appreciate your time and involvement.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1108%2E62735%2EnWjKET)
Peter, this is a long but important email about access to mifepristone, a drug used in medication abortions.
Last month, the Supreme Court heard arguments in a completely bogus case that could restrict parts of the FDA’s approval of a critical (and safe) drug, mifepristone, used in medication abortions. **The Supreme Court will soon decide whether to keep mifepristone available or reinstate dangerous restrictions on it.**
We need to be clear about this: Medication abortions accounted for the majority — 63% — of all abortions last year. _Any_ attempt to ban mifepristone and medication abortion is an attack on women’s reproductive freedom.
Our legal system is fundamentally broken if a legally and medically unfounded case like this one can make it all the way to the Supreme Court. **We _must_ change the status quo in Washington, and that’s not going to happen until we change who we send to Congress.**
**[In the Senate, I’ll fight to protect abortion access at the federal level _and_ fix the broken system that got us here in the first place. If you’re with me, please sign our petition in support of mifepristone!](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324&t=2&akid=1108%2E62735%2EnWjKET)**
**[SIGN ON »](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324&t=3&akid=1108%2E62735%2EnWjKET)**
Born into a family where stethoscopes & lab coats were symbols of dedication and service, I understand deeply the sanctity of the medical profession. My parents, both esteemed doctors, and my grandparents, who also devoted their lives to medicine, instilled in me an unwavering respect for the noble pursuit of healthcare.
**Abortion is an integral part of healthcare. It must remain a decision made in the sanctity of a doctor-patient relationship, free from the overreach of government.**
I will not sit idly by and watch the Supreme Court decide a case that will impose unnecessary roadblocks to the prescription and distribution of a safe drug. I will not sit idly by and watch extremist Republicans put their far-right agenda above the will of the voters. **And I will not sit idly by when the power to build a better future for Michigan and the nation is _entirely within our hands._**
**[Peter, I hope you’ll join me. Please, sign our campaign’s petition to keep mifepristone safe, legal, and accessible. Our voice is our power.](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324/?source=em_HHR_PET_MifepristoneSCOTUS_040324&t=4&akid=1108%2E62735%2EnWjKET)**
In solidarity,
Hill Harper

**_CHAIRMAN'S CLUB_ \- _PREMIUM LEVEL_**

A stylish quarter-zipper sweater

**_CAPITOL CLUB_ \- _PREFERRED LEVEL_**

[**Join us today and be part of a membership that believes in The People of Nebraska. Click here to register and pick the membership level that suits you best.**](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a4e83fb051&e=25844e23a8)

name: Mike Johnson [Speaker of the House]
subject: Fire and brimstone
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.theconservativewins.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=263c2531d262467090204158a12819c8&_e=bXru-D8VMenpEGRu1I8QCF9XVHM1YH4kaLd6GImGRs8eFVEVxFMTkERb2ZCdP1Jj2Y5V75vS-e1GA0QZ-CYrrCfy4H3OB-yvn6IAdj7AmvHudNHBd-0NQilEorDA8WB6eL5fkl4lU3txiIAKmQqgdCqxk5gCtfXSfGM71Plfl7iM2xtLL4AUk5his3CUdPIQDkZZivLYHWC9bPZU4zfK8ogWUEMpnMkC6KZRdjkQQi9EjIUd5Hgu0gHj9ZGE3udX7VZGdRzWpC6ygXcfwVMwepgwOJUdu-W4xZKy-fsZPhjFfqU2hgfL5mnkZPd2KXOMfVd_7BcB2hg391LdWIMi_Q-zJT91IV4EjVJUE30t-5xWdGVaFzhCztqKRMRLnHBw0v0T4hUMJGILvYVVpUfY2bFuf8GR06lWs4-WlC1uhhA%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.theconservativewins.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=263c2531d262467090204158a12819c8&_e=bXru-D8VMenpEGRu1I8QCF9XVHM1YH4kaLd6GImGRs8eFVEVxFMTkERb2ZCdP1Jj2Y5V75vS-e1GA0QZ-CYrrCfy4H3OB-yvn6IAdj7AmvHudNHBd-0NQilEorDA8WB6eL5fkl4lU3txiIAKmQqgdCqxk5gCtfXSfGM71Plfl7iM2xtLL4AUk5his3CUdPIQDkZZivLYHWC9bPZU4zfK8ogWUEMpnMkC6KZRdjkQQi9EjIUd5Hgu0gHj9ZGE3udX7VZGdRzWpC6ygXcfwVMwegPjdkJfQheVlbdYGgNDpKkrnvD0HUmwkghSJ9QWbNHqqc40NwuRj0eIPg1WD-KzhXERUPbgA7M3T40lV8p8mBDg81xnXRLk3gU8CHqhzVHWwuHEWLao05MJ7LqSOilOc_UsyB7s9iFjWddH_uD8uLs%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://links.theconservativewins.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=263c2531d262467090204158a12819c8&_e=bXru-D8VMenpEGRu1I8QCF9XVHM1YH4kaLd6GImGRs8eFVEVxFMTkERb2ZCdP1Jj2Y5V75vS-e1GA0QZ-CYrrCfy4H3OB-yvn6IAdj7AmvHudNHBd-0NQilEorDA8WB6eL5fkl4lU3txiIAKmQqgdCqxk5gCtfXSfGM71Plfl7iM2xtLL4AUk5his3CUdPIQDkZZivLYHWC9bPZU4zfK8ogWUEMpnMkC6KZRdjkQQi9EjIUd5Hgu0gHj9ZGE3udX7VZGdRzWpC6ygXcfwVMwen4ewXQXxeSFvlQ64xkdJ9ZGQsH2AgdJZKyjaioPvyIeHSVm7wtbQPRvg2CQ8g6Dpad1f7zTe5gO98tDhCf1bbyb8vGNGDWBoQAFIRwazpSD-TjRqClmj1W_SDp8T1EosRSvFZsDL-8bR9M6FFNq1ug%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that's what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?

With a Democratic majority and White House, we will protect and strengthen Social Security and Medicare. Republicans will gut them.
**“Trump suggests Medicare and Social Security benefit cuts on CNBC”**
_-Business Insider_
Did you hear, team?

Donald Trump told _CNBC_ that he is willing to cut Social Security.

And it didn't take House Republicans long to follow suit. **Last month, House Republicans called for stripping Americans of their hard-earned benefits by raising the age of retirement in their latest budget proposal.**

It is simple: With a Democratic majority and White House, we will protect and strengthen Social Security and Medicare. Republicans like Mike Lawler will gut them.

[**Cutting Social Security and Medicare—critical lifelines for millions of Americans—is unconscionable. Time and time again, Republicans in Congress put Social Security on the chopping block to pay for their handouts to greedy corporations and billionaires.

Just one week after becoming House Speaker—which Mike Lawler’s vote made possible—Mike Johnson pledged to continue the crusade against Medicare and Social Security. This latest news proves Mike Johnson and Republicans are willing and eager to deliver on their promise.

As millions of working families are struggling to keep up with the rising costs due to corporate price gouging, leaders in Congress should be fighting to lower costs and make life easier for everyday Americans.

subject: From Jim Crow to Congress

body:
| | | Friend, My parents grew up in the Jim Crow South. At every turn, they faced hate and discrimination. They were told they were less than because of the color of their skin. **With the help of brave Americans across the country, we dismantled the Jim Crow era. Now, my parents, who had to use “colored” water fountains, have a son who’s serving in Washington DC.** **_Only in America could we go from Jim Crow to Congress in one generation, and my family and I are living proof._ **
---
[**DEFEND THE AMERICAN DREAM**](http://links.jjforcongress.com/u/click?_t=f784024d18db4d2d88c26e9627b85cc7&_m=dd8ca65d0e1748519e79f285bd301ddc&_e=0lUWdOTGFgRMB9-GZsZqW9Fe29ua96o8qN2ZcH2pAvE4_FmknBrQAiZsQDbCc9J7UssahdfM3MLIG8KixIJUpuFrE7yDoFU6n1BzjZ8PpRfJWF6EvBd_JVNweHxhKXFpKtdMpDcghCjUFmXwYFkypd7zbUaXkvZFrB2L-3JsQD7AQPMKk7xgFRHa50RqUeqQOtauMFMRhoC2zLF30x-P-BuIlVtKW_IYMtJF0N-36IivA3q0sUXt98OvqZVKykc72VhKgu2AtMoQwyU2_tlxaOhN5gld8tfuO9EMJzVS5GwWFZkaj3eT0u-km-dv6Fb7U5xXDYaquW86CiXas7aQ17O5YxD8pPvJgRCRvyJKax0%3D)
---
The Left think that because I’m a Republican, I’m not _really_ black.** ** **Joe Biden certainly thinks so. Just listen to his “you ain’t black” or “he’s gonna put y’all back in chains” tirades.**** ** Let me be clear, those statements aren’t gaffes, they are indicative of how Democrats _truly_ feel.** ** **Democrats believe that to be “black” means that you must be dependent on them.******** ** **That is their entire business model. Democrats know that if they can keep black Americans just poor enough to where they’re not starving—that the voters will be dependent on the handouts that the Democrats offer them.
**
I have a message to those Democrats like Biden who say that people like Tim Scott, Thomas Sowell, Clarence Thomas and me “ain’t black.” _ __I’m a Republican BECAUSE I’m black, not in spite of it._
* I believe in opportunity for all people regardless of skin color.
* I believe in every American’s right to think for themselves.
* I believe in conservative values and economic prosperity.

When I see the woke mob trying to divide us based on where we come from or what we look like, I’m reminded of the segregated society my parents grew up in. That TERRIFIES ME.

The woke mob has created an economy of race hatred that keeps people angry enough to continue to vote for them.

**I’m dedicated to defeating them.**

America is the land of opportunity, and I ran for Congress because I will do everything in my power to keep it that way.****** ** **[Now, I need your help. I’m a top target for the bigoted Left because my family’s story is living proof of what is possible for black Americans. Will you chip in now and help me continue my fight?](http://links.jjforcongress.com/u/click?_t=f784024d18db4d2d88c26e9627b85cc7&_m=dd8ca65d0e1748519e79f285bd301ddc&_e=0lUWdOTGFgRMB9-GZsZqW9Fe29ua96o8qN2ZcH2pAvE4_FmknBrQAiZsQDbCc9J7UssahdfM3MLIG8KixIJUpuFrE7yDoFU6n1BzjZ8PpRfJWF6EvBd_JVNweHxhKXFpKtdMpDcghCjUFmXwYFkypd7zbUaXkvZFrB2L-3JsQD7AQPMKk7xgFRHa50RqUeqQOtauMFMRhoC2zLF30x-P-BmJ9ogSl18pw7nw8WvACWNPW7FALuvSnkCAeT8ixJeJG2FgH2YOHaIETTb8lAbZep14Lk4T3BcWr-nY-RO5xybFjO9DpHyLz7LPNTJhNr4MuJ858aAYErHqpW4dfT_axiTZ0q_Gb2NNZI4G2WmoEFg%3D)**

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: This is food for the soul
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
#
There’s something deeply fulfilling about registering voters on a sunny afternoon in my hometown. Meeting Texans who’ve never voted before and bringing them onto the rolls so they can cast a ballot for the very first time — it’s food for the soul.

Last week, I joined a group of Powered by People volunteers at the University of Texas at El Paso to register students to vote. Some had just turned 18. Others have been eligible to vote for years but said no one had ever reached out to encourage them to register.
But after talking with them about what’s at stake in this election and their role in helping us win big, important Texas races, they were pumped to get registered and to vote this November.
[**I hope you’ll pitch in $5, $10, or whatever you can today to help us keep this work going. Your contribution helps us register and organize the voters who will make the difference in 2024 and beyond.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240403.KUrNbp&refcode=ema20240403-239539&t=1&akid=239539%2E444211%2EsHj5E5)
**[DONATE $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240403.KUrNbp&refcode=ema20240403-239539&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=239539%2E444211%2EsHj5E5)**
Every time I get out there, I come home with a renewed belief that if we keep up this work, keep having these conversations, keep bringing new voters into this fight, we’re going to win elections that put good people in power and help our country make it through these trying times.
So let’s keep the faith and keep doing the work!
Beto

I hope everyone who celebrated with family this weekend enjoyed a delightful Easter! I was happy to take some time to relax, spend time with my family, and enjoy the Virginia outdoors with my family. Sunday also marked the end of our fundraising quarter, and I was happy to report to the rest of our team that we exceeded our March fundraising goal. Now, as we look ahead to April, we’re focused on having an even stronger fundraising quarter, and we need your support to begin on a positive note. At the end of this fundraising quarter, we’ll report our numbers for all to see, and it’s incredibly important we show the true strength of our network. While I know it might seem early, we have a lot of work to do to lay the foundation for our campaign — including hiring more staff, canvassing, connecting with voters, and building up our infrastructure for 2025 (and using it to make sure we win up and down the ballot in 2024!). Abigail has always faced close races in the past, but this race will be different. She’s running to represent the entire Commonwealth of Virginia, and it takes resources to visit every corner of Virginia and listen directly to as many voters as possible. subject: Judicial Watch Sues State Department for Communications of Top Officials Regarding Tucker Carlson
body:
Judicial Watch announced today it filed a Freedom of Information Act
(FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. State Department for all emails and
diplomatic notes from Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Deputy
Secretary of State Victoria Nuland and other top department officials
that reference former Fox News host Tucker Carlson (Judicial Watch v.
U.S. Department of State (No. 1:24-cv-00840)).

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=139fb5ece0b0424cb3e214d7f64e5958&_e=Lgx1epWNWcZJmGuQKqUja8tbuG1fejDrK-ElkDmOIsL5yqpamDLrdr9Knw3JNOBuAfkOz86RBV6tlIH5tCFQSvJ0ifqJs9tTVTsWShKm6lFB6RLPr5BC8HtZfDuDERcz79llal-OFELsw6yko8fCvEZ16dAeSgtvwEOuRiTIC6iKNK6Glm3H4DqSrHN24I2JgAhHa1AmfmjTxurf6MSSzWOzCV4jI9jL6dufbiC9HoATVqQBKKNEb0Gnp1hWqqemi1n6p76ZKZSHatoWd7mWyjQ84N8Q3JoQBoiF5z8vIJxd67cDFF6ebIgVdjqoZXGRviCHvGH-RI6kgpb_a709OPokDVMKr8kBbUP9VzRz9_SMdnxHOLmMe3VbOP_QyZPhagf20vsz6hg-1RvgmTXHFtDLy6f89GH3nJjvOIHqNXw%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=139fb5ece0b0424cb3e214d7f64e5958&_e=Lgx1epWNWcZJmGuQKqUja8tbuG1fejDrK-ElkDmOIsL5yqpamDLrdr9Knw3JNOBuAfkOz86RBV6tlIH5tCFQSvJ0ifqJs9tTVTsWShKm6lFB6RLPr5BC8HtZfDuDERcz79llal-OFELsw6yko8fCvEZ16dAeSgtvwEOuRiTIC6iKNK6Glm3H4DqSrHN24I2JgAhHa1AmfmjTxurf6MSSzWOzCV4jI9jL6dufbiC9HoATVqQBKKNEb0Gnp1hWqqemdX-W9h0A9mZ1DBW71BU7b0jIWzbK9RfqsHmIvappxhMR9xwZWe42suMZ80u0ksasqhq6EDHLdM85imvQ62w_qC1tZYjPx5s-Q76CC1CDAFR-5hPtfMulYEVxMSjAxCruu0vXgA02jKPoSAmr_yO6f772sUNiyQbD4Cz6Sy_DVGs%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=139fb5ece0b0424cb3e214d7f64e5958&_e=Lgx1epWNWcZJmGuQKqUja8tbuG1fejDrK-ElkDmOIsL5yqpamDLrdr9Knw3JNOBuAfkOz86RBV6tlIH5tCFQSvJ0ifqJs9tTVTsWShKm6lFB6RLPr5BC8HtZfDuDERcz79llal-OFELsw6yko8fCvEZ16dAeSgtvwEOuRiTIC6iKNK6Glm3H4DqSrHN24I2JgAhHa1AmfmjTxurf6MSSzWOzCV4jI9jL6dufbiC9HoATVqQBKKNEb0Gnp1hWqqemmXwleCcjyGD4hD9KcjlwDWY0zvCpVarAayJPQe3BEwav2FhsP_dZU1aplZkMeNklutB7EEHZyGAOBLSveQHpub0LTtOMut_SbYvCYHo1AWXmz8I_eNV6CCRtlR10qE85macLEhN6aFhnxy0waGnWSs7QnHBEYyjRJNu_sh2s9-o%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

Raquel

| | Dear Peter,For far too long the New York Times has dominated American journalism. It calls itself the "paper of record" and claims it publishes "all the news that's fit to print."But Americans know that the Times doesn't have their best interests at heart. Dear Peter,
When you visit ‘O Rew, you can see what makes this place so special – surrounded by the lush forests of Redwood National and State Parks, with a fresh sense of healing and hope in the air as we continue our work with the Yurok Tribe to restore this former mill site.
Last month, we shared the historic news of a landmark agreement that outlines our plan to transfer ownership of ‘O Rew back to its original stewards, the Yurok Tribe. This is a first step toward the creation of [**‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82302009/464950397/-1245812088?contactdata=IV404bZp6BgFWBkLU1WLcqAq/hmrhMD2n5e0/TwAfBP5lXXjVf4sVdFksGzuPLWtoGWIItJ4JEoHujC0zxF3pAByY1EEiCQhXl9u7oMm7hpriq2k7Srm0KrnPI1VsGstPjiDkGRHc8jXDH5BuZ/n+HLmDExgowwgN9rdw0sfSgE=&ms=Orew_Email2_Link1&sourceid=1165243&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUyMWNmZGM3LWY0ZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wyrAe-Egbh24dMf_tCP8ogZOPRgLahvi-9P6AogRnf0=&emci=9b3f0b67-f9ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=e21cfdc7-f4f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=1504551), an exciting new destination to include hiking trails, interpretive exhibits, and direct access to the spectacular groves of Redwood National and State Parks.
Today, I invite you to [**join in helping to raise the funds we need to transform this site into a world-class, Indigenous-owned recreational gateway**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82302010/464950398/-873745280?contactdata=IV404bZp6BgFWBkLU1WLcqAq/hmrhMD2n5e0/TwAfBP5lXXjVf4sVdFksGzuPLWtoGWIItJ4JEoHujC0zxF3pAByY1EEiCQhXl9u7oMm7hpriq2k7Srm0KrnPI1VsGstPjiDkGRHc8jXDH5BuZ/n+HLmDExgowwgN9rdw0sfSgE=&ms=Orew_Email2_Link2&sourceid=1165243&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUyMWNmZGM3LWY0ZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wyrAe-Egbh24dMf_tCP8ogZOPRgLahvi-9P6AogRnf0=&emci=9b3f0b67-f9ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=e21cfdc7-f4f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=1504551). With $7 million in support already identified, we need $2 million in additional funding to get us over the finish line.
[**Can I count on you to help the League make this exciting vision a reality?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82302011/464950399/-873745280?contactdata=IV404bZp6BgFWBkLU1WLcqAq/hmrhMD2n5e0/TwAfBP5lXXjVf4sVdFksGzuPLWtoGWIItJ4JEoHujC0zxF3pAByY1EEiCQhXl9u7oMm7hpriq2k7Srm0KrnPI1VsGstPjiDkGRHc8jXDH5BuZ/n+HLmDExgowwgN9rdw0sfSgE=&ms=Orew_Email2_Link3&sourceid=1165243&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUyMWNmZGM3LWY0ZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wyrAe-Egbh24dMf_tCP8ogZOPRgLahvi-9P6AogRnf0=&emci=9b3f0b67-f9ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=e21cfdc7-f4f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=1504551)

clean_body: An ancient forest and millennia of history Dear Peter, When you visit ‘O Rew, you can see what makes this place so special – surrounded by the lush forests of Redwood National and State Parks, with a fresh sense of healing and hope in the air as we continue our work with the Yurok Tribe to restore this former mill site. Last month, we shared the historic news of a landmark agreement that outlines our plan to transfer ownership of ‘O Rew back to its original stewards, the Yurok Tribe. This is a first step toward the creation of , an exciting new destination to include hiking trails, interpretive exhibits, and direct access to the spectacular groves of Redwood National and State Parks. Today, I invite you to . With $7 million in support already identified, we need $2 million in additional funding to get us over the finish line. | New accessible trails including a wetland trail, a forest loop trail that is also a segment of the California Coastal Trail, and trail connections to the beautiful old-growth redwoods of Lady Bird Johnson Grove. ---|--- | Interpretive exhibits that engage visitors in learning about the site restoration, redwood ecosystems, and the living culture of the Yurok people. ---|--- | Robust visitor amenities where the Yurok Tribe can welcome the public to explore the majesty of the redwood forest and their ancestral lands. ---|--- Your contribution is a direct investment in the revival of this beautiful site that holds so much significance – ecologically and culturally. This project is a momentous one – years in the making. We have plenty of meaningful work to do before the final transfer of the property in 2026. But I am filled with hope and excitement, knowing that in the near future, forest lovers like you from across the state – and the world – can experience the significance of ‘O Rew and Yurok culture in the redwoods first-hand. Thank you for helping us revive and restore this remarkable site. Warmly, | Sam Hodder President and CEO ---|--- * | | | | ---|---|---|--- Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States tel:415-362-2352 | |

---
**One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven’t heard about it.** Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason — conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that’s not an exaggeration; we’ve experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person (“Admiral” Rachel Levine) as a man. It’s gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. **_That’s why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws._**
---
[Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9_X7z4iHhBQzY1SdEz4rLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn8EymP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ040Nzk5OVcDc3BjQgpmBAe5DWZHWzZcUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
This is nothing new for us. We’ve long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we’ve taken on over the years:
* We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page.
* We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech."
* We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery.
* We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers
* We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks

Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn’t easy or inexpensive, but it’s the right thing to do. And it’s making a difference. But we can’t do it without you. **[**Will you become a paid subscriber to The Babylon Bee to help us stay in the fight?**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9_X7z4iHhBQzY1SdEz4rLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn8EymP0RSaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVVTQ040Nzk5OVcDc3BjQgpmBAe5DWZHWzZcUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

body:
VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd

Fellow American,

The radical left is pushing policies that are dangerous to the American people - defunding the police, soft on crime initiatives, liberal prosecutors that don’t even follow the law, and a wide open border that allows criminals and terrorists to enter our country at will. Joe Biden and Susan Wild are in lockstep on these issues and they are more concerned about protecting criminals and other countries’ borders instead of fighting crime and securing the U.S border.

Let me be clear: I will fight every day to stop the invasion at our southern border. We need to build the wall and deport those who have broken the law.

President Trump asked for $5 billion to secure our border but the Democrats scoffed and Susan Wild was a part of efforts by Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer to shut down the government over that funding fight. Fast forward to 2024 and we have already sent $113 billion to protect Ukraine's border with no progress at securing our own. In fact, our border is more open than ever!

Enough is enough! We need to send an American First candidate to Washington to take on the radicals and put our security front and center.

This is why I am proud to announce that, just a few weeks ago, I received support from the Allentown Fraternal Order of Police and am the only candidate to receive an endorsement from a local Sheriff (Carbon County Sheriff Dan Zeigler) in Pennsylvania’s 7th congressional district. My pledge to law enforcement is that I will stand up for them and support them. Thank you to all of our law enforcement officers who are working to keep us safe!

Here are a few updates from the campaign:
* Supported by Allentown FOP and Carbon County Sheriff
* Easter across our community
* Request your mail-in ballot
* Ryan Mackenzie Morning Call Op-Ed

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,

-Ryan Mackenzie

SUPPORTED! Queen City Lodge #10 Fraternal Order of Police

Supporting the men and women in Blue is a top priority of mine. That is why David Benner, President of FOP Lodge 10 said, “Queen City Lodge 10 Fraternal Order of Police express our support for your campaign for US Congress.” I am also proud to have the endorsement of Carbon County sheriff Dan Zeigler. Sheriff Zeigler said “ Ryan has what it takes to keep our community safe.”

Easter In Our Community

I hope everyone had a wonderful and blessed Easter. On Saturday, members of #TeamMackenzie joined families in Allentown for an Easter Egg hunt. It was great seeing so many smiling faces!

Request Your Mail-in Ballot

President Trump has been pushing Republicans to vote by mail and bank their vote. There are lots of other Republican efforts underway to encourage mail voting. If there is any chance that you might be absent from the polls on April 23rd or helping #TeamMackenzie on Election Day, please request your mail-in ballot right away!

One way you can ensure a victory for me is by telling Republican friends and family that typically don't vote in the primary to request a mail-in ballot so they can vote for me and send an America First candidate to Washington D.C. The last day to request a mail-in ballot is April 16th. Those interested in applying for a mail-in ballot can do so here: https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/OnlineAbsenteeApplication/#/OnlineAbsenteeBegin

Reminder: The last day to register to vote for the Republican Primary is April 8th.

IN THE NEWS

Check out my Morning Call Op-Ed on why I am running for U.S. Congress.
Read Here: Morning Call Op-Ed (https://www.mcall.com/2024/04/03/election-2024-your-view-by-ryan-mackenzie-my-experience-in-harrisburg-will-help-me-address-illegal-immigration-economy/)

We need to demand that Congress and the Biden administration use their leverage — either by suspending weapons shipments or ending military funding — to force Israel to comply with the UNSC resolution. | | | Peter,
Despite last week’s UN Security Council resolution urging an immediate ceasefire in Gaza during Ramadan, the situation for Palestinians in the region is growing even more dire as Israeli attacks persist — with no signs of stopping. The situation on the ground is getting worse by the day, with U.S. officials warning of imminent famine in Gaza. **On Monday, CNN reported that the Biden administration is preparing to approve the sale of an estimated 50 US-made F-15 fighter jets to Israel, along with missiles and precision-guidance kits. 1** The deal, likely worth over $18 billion, would be the largest US military sale to Israel since October 7th. **Then, yesterday, an Israeli airstrike targeted and killed seven aid workers from the international food charity, World Central Kitchen. 2** It happened just hours after the group brought a new shipload of food into northern Gaza, where hundreds of thousands of Palestinians are facing starvation and famine as a result of Israel’s months-long blockade of humanitarian aid deliveries by land. **On the same day, Israeli forces _also_ escalated hostilities beyond their borders, bombing an Iranian consulate in Damascus, Syria,3 and left Al Shifa Hospital — the largest medical complex in the Gaza Strip — in ruins, after a two-week raid.4** Amid all of this escalating violence, it can be easy to fall into the trap of despair. But we must not. In a vote last week, the UN Security Council _finally_ managed to pass a resolution calling for a ceasefire in Gaza.5 Instead of vetoing the resolution, the Biden administration abstained, ensuring that it passed — and signaling that _our pressure is working, Peter._ **Now, we need to demand that Congress and the Biden administration use their leverage — either by suspending weapons shipments or ending military funding — to force Israel to comply with the UNSC resolution.** [**At least 85 members of Congress have now called for a ceasefire — and our voices are making a difference. Let's keep the pressure on, Peter. clean_body: We need to demand that Congress and the Biden administration use their leverage — either by suspending weapons shipments or ending military funding — to force Israel to comply with the UNSC resolution. | | | Peter, Despite last week’s UN Security Council resolution urging an immediate ceasefire in Gaza during Ramadan, the situation for Palestinians in the region is growing even more dire as Israeli attacks persist — with no signs of stopping. The situation on the ground is getting worse by the day, with U.S. officials warning of imminent famine in Gaza. On Monday, CNN reported that the Biden administration is preparing to approve the sale of an estimated 50 US-made F-15 fighter jets to Israel, along with missiles and precision-guidance kits. 1 The deal, likely worth over $18 billion, would be the largest US military sale to Israel since October 7th. Then, yesterday, an Israeli airstrike targeted and killed seven aid workers from the international food charity, World Central Kitchen. 2 It happened just hours after the group brought a new shipload of food into northern Gaza, where hundreds of thousands of Palestinians are facing starvation and famine as a result of Israel’s months-long blockade of humanitarian aid deliveries by land. On the same day, Israeli forces also escalated hostilities beyond their borders, bombing an Iranian consulate in Damascus, Syria,3 and left Al Shifa Hospital — the largest medical complex in the Gaza Strip — in ruins, after a two-week raid.4 Amid all of this escalating violence, it can be easy to fall into the trap of despair. But we must not. In a vote last week, the UN Security Council finally managed to pass a resolution calling for a ceasefire in Gaza.5 Instead of vetoing the resolution, the Biden administration abstained, ensuring that it passed — and signaling that our pressure is working, Peter. Now, we need to demand that Congress and the Biden administration use their leverage — either by suspending weapons shipments or ending military funding — to force Israel to comply with the UNSC resolution. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , CNN, April 1, 2024. 2\. , CBS News , April 2, 2024. 3\. , The New York Times , April 2, 2024. 4\. , The Guardian , April 1, 2024. 5\. , UN News , March 25, 2024. There’s a local elected body in Texas you’ve probably never heard of — the Brownsville Navigation District Commission. This commission plays a pivotal role in bringing some of the biggest polluters and most hazardous jobs to the valley. There's an upcoming election for Commissioner seats that could dramatically shift this dynamic. _You’ve heard us talk about Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) projects a lot lately._ That’s because LNG is the next big climate fight — it’s just another form of dirty energy being pushed by Big Fossil Fuels to slow our transition to a true, clean energy economy. Here’s what’s going on in Brownsville: There is a colossal LNG project looming. name: Sen. Heidi Campbell
subject: A Note From Heidi: There’s no place more beautiful than Nashville in the spring
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Campbell for State Senate, Lee Jones, treasurer
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Newsletter%20Header.png]
Dear Neighbors,
I hope you’re enjoying this gorgeous weather. I’ve always maintained that there’s no place more beautiful than Nashville in the spring. And we have so many amazing parks and local attractions in middle Tennessee.
Earth day is on Monday April 22nd this year, and there are a lot of opportunities to celebrate and to support environmental stewardship in this newsletter. Our office continues to work on legislation to address expansion of reduction and recycling infrastructure, and to oppose bills that threaten Tennessee wetlands and clean air and water regulations. To alter a famous Mark Twain quote- “ protect our land- they’re not making it anymore."
Most senate committees have already closed for the year, but we are likely to be in session for several more weeks as the senate and house suss out their plan for the voucher bill. I continue to actively oppose this plan because it will be ruinous for our state.
Though It would be amazing if the plan could actually create an opportunity for Tennessee families to choose the best education for their children, the real intent is to funnel our hard-earned tax dollars to out-of-state investors who have spent hundreds of millions to market the idea that this will help Tennesseans. It will destroy public education and increase our tax burden significantly- and we will have to raise taxes to subsidize it. I am hopeful that the significant differences between the house and senate versions will be irreconcilable.
As this session winds down I’m disappointed that my colleagues would not vote for our strong slate of gun-reform legislation (though we have a few more bills on the agenda this week), and I’m alarmed by the continued attacks on democratic norms and on women’s reproductive rights. But I’m also proud of a lot of the legislation that we’ve passed and that we’ve prevented from passing.
As always feel free to reach out to me if you have any questions, concerns, or suggestions. I always love to hear from you. My cell phone number is 615.438.6338.
Warmly,
Heidi

Earth Day Volunteer Opportunities
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Earth%2BDay%2BLogo.png] Earth Day Festival at Centennial Park [https://www.hon.org/opportunity/a0CVN00000JhZz82AF/nashville-earth-day-festival-in-centennial-park]
Nashville's Annual Earth Day Festival [https://www.nashvilleearthday.org/] is taking place on Saturday, April 20th from 11am-5pm. Multiple volunteer shifts are available - 7:30-10:15am, 10:15am-1pm, 1-3:45pm, and 3:45-6:30pm. Volunteers will be helping with vendor set-up and registration, parking and traffic monitoring, "Green Sweeping" litter collection in the park, partnering with waste management at the Recycling Stations, assisting the Conservancy Booth with fundraising, merch, and surveys, and tear-down and clean-up.
Garden Harvesting and Maintenance [https://www.hon.org/opportunity/a0CVN00000IbyZr2AJ/garden-harvesting-and-maintenance] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/bell.png]
Bell Garden in Bellevue [https://bellgardentn.org/about/] is building healthier and deeper connected communities through garden based service, education, volunteerism, and food distribution. They have a number of different gardens and growing locations, a portable kitchen classroom, and a farm stand. On April 20th from 9am-12pm, they are looking for volunteers to help with harvesting, deadheading flowers, weeding, and assisting with other projects.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/PNG%20image.jpeg] Chestnut Hill NeighborhoodLitter [https://www.hon.org/opportunity/a0CVN00000FRsR42AL/litter-pick-up-in-chestnut-hill-neighborhood]
Clean Up [https://www.hon.org/opportunity/a0CVN00000FRsR42AL/litter-pick-up-in-chestnut-hill-neighborhood]
Turnip Green Creative Reuse [https://turnipgreencreativereuse.org/] is looking for volunteers on Saturday, April 20th from 11am-12:30pm to join them in a neighborhood litter clean up in the Chestnut Hill neighborhood. Volunteers will be provided with vests, grabbers, gloves, and trash bags. Turnip Green Creative Reuse diverts usable material from our landfill to creative efforts. Every day, they take in over 1000 pounds of donated material through a pay-as-you-can store and educational programming.
Community Garden Tending [https://www.hon.org/opportunity/a0CVN00000Nar2O2AR/help-tend-our-community-garden] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/IMG_6244.png]
Healing Minds and Souls brings trauma healing to Nashville through educational classes, resources, and fostering wholeness among the community. They're looking for volunteers every Saturday morning from 9-11am to help plant, weed, water, and harvest their community garden. The garden provides fresh produce to community members who might not otherwise have access.

clean_body: [] Dear Neighbors, I hope you’re enjoying this gorgeous weather. I’ve always maintained that there’s no place more beautiful than Nashville in the spring. And we have so many amazing parks and local attractions in middle Tennessee. Earth day is on Monday April 22nd this year, and there are a lot of opportunities to celebrate and to support environmental stewardship in this newsletter. Our office continues to work on legislation to address expansion of reduction and recycling infrastructure, and to oppose bills that threaten Tennessee wetlands and clean air and water regulations. To alter a famous Mark Twain quote- “ protect our land- they’re not making it anymore." Most senate committees have already closed for the year, but we are likely to be in session for several more weeks as the senate and house suss out their plan for the voucher bill. I continue to actively oppose this plan because it will be ruinous for our state. Though It would be amazing if the plan could actually create an opportunity for Tennessee families to choose the best education for their children, the real intent is to funnel our hard-earned tax dollars to out-of-state investors who have spent hundreds of millions to market the idea that this will help Tennesseans. It will destroy public education and increase our tax burden significantly- and we will have to raise taxes to subsidize it. I am hopeful that the significant differences between the house and senate versions will be irreconcilable. As this session winds down I’m disappointed that my colleagues would not vote for our strong slate of gun-reform legislation (though we have a few more bills on the agenda this week), and I’m alarmed by the continued attacks on democratic norms and on women’s reproductive rights. But I’m also proud of a lot of the legislation that we’ve passed and that we’ve prevented from passing. As always feel free to reach out to me if you have any questions, concerns, or suggestions. I always love to hear from you. My cell phone number is 615.438.6338. Warmly, Heidi [] Earth Day Volunteer Opportunities [] Earth Day Festival at Centennial Park [] Nashville's Annual Earth Day Festival [] is taking place on Saturday, April 20th from 11am-5pm. Multiple volunteer shifts are available - 7:30-10:15am, 10:15am-1pm, 1-3:45pm, and 3:45-6:30pm. Volunteers will be helping with vendor set-up and registration, parking and traffic monitoring, "Green Sweeping" litter collection in the park, partnering with waste management at the Recycling Stations, assisting the Conservancy Booth with fundraising, merch, and surveys, and tear-down and clean-up. Garden Harvesting and Maintenance [] [] Bell Garden in Bellevue [] is building healthier and deeper connected communities through garden based service, education, volunteerism, and food distribution. They have a number of different gardens and growing locations, a portable kitchen classroom, and a farm stand. On April 20th from 9am-12pm, they are looking for volunteers to help with harvesting, deadheading flowers, weeding, and assisting with other projects. [] Chestnut Hill NeighborhoodLitter [] Clean Up [] Turnip Green Creative Reuse [] is looking for volunteers on Saturday, April 20th from 11am-12:30pm to join them in a neighborhood litter clean up in the Chestnut Hill neighborhood. Volunteers will be provided with vests, grabbers, gloves, and trash bags. Turnip Green Creative Reuse diverts usable material from our landfill to creative efforts. Every day, they take in over 1000 pounds of donated material through a pay-as-you-can store and educational programming. Community Garden Tending [] [] Healing Minds and Souls brings trauma healing to Nashville through educational classes, resources, and fostering wholeness among the community. They're looking for volunteers every Saturday morning from 9-11am to help plant, weed, water, and harvest their community garden. The garden provides fresh produce to community members who might not otherwise have access.
