body:
Our 2024 Boot Camp is May 3 on St. Thomas.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/1422062dd56e/re-hey-10288486?e=d30db4cde8)
Friend,

Our boot camp for candidates, candidate campaign team members, Republican State Committee members, and anyone interested in being more politically active is confirmed for Friday, May 3.

The boot camp will run from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. with a break for lunch.

Conducting the training are A-list Republicans Robert Arnakis, Angela Faulkner and Rob Burgess.

Arnakis is the senior director of domestic and international programs for The Leadership Institute in suburban Washington. He oversees divisions which provide political education and consultation to senior government officials, public policy leaders and influencers. His background includes serving as senior staff to multiple presidential and congressional campaigns. Additionally, Arnakis has consulting experience with multiple grassroots driven organizations. Recently, he worked with the conservative prime minister of Jamaica.

After years of working in the campaign field, Faulkner founded Gridiron Communications in 2003, a nationwide targeted direct mail firm that worked with businesses, candidates and organizations to best position them in the mind of their targeted recipients. In 2005, she was joined by her husband, Chris, after serving on President Bush’s re-election campaign. Pollie and Reed Award winner Gridiron Communications was nationally renowned for its targeted and creative direct mail, interactive training sessions and their innovative issue-based advocacy coordination campaigns. The company was acquired by Majority Strategies, where Chris is now a partner and national strategist. Faulkner is a past board member and instructor for the Women’s Campaign School at Yale University and was a guest trainer for Harvard’s Women and Public Policy Program at the John F. Kennedy School of Government.

In his role as chief strategist, Burgess oversees Connector Labs’ developing and diverse portfolio of political clients. His distinguished career encompasses nearly 18 years of political and communications experience on races ranging from city council to six presidential campaigns. Additional experience extends to Capitol Hill, where Burgess is considered an expert on congressional mass communications. He has also served as communications director to several members of Congress, including Trey Hollingsworth and Mike Garcia.

In addition to St. Thomas participants, we have a contingent coming over from St. Croix. If you need assistance with logistics, please let me know. Right now, Cape Air has the best airfares for same-day travel between the islands.

Anyone wanting to run as a Republican in 2024 will need to attend. To confirm your attendance, simply reply to this email.

Thanks, and I look forward to seeing you on May 3.

body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82304131/464957539/-575414752?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzZDdkNzNmLWZiZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N3J_lfHomYYYj1A2PMvLh9a3Afhvz2HeCkuTB9WVJDE=&emci=bff20ee6-52f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=93d7d73f-fbf1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=2107230) | | | Hi Peter, What if I told you that Oregon ranks in the bottom of Western states for conservation efforts, as seen in the new report from our partners at Center for Western Priorities? [**_Check out the report here._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82304133/464957540/2016177749?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzZDdkNzNmLWZiZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N3J_lfHomYYYj1A2PMvLh9a3Afhvz2HeCkuTB9WVJDE=&emci=bff20ee6-52f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=93d7d73f-fbf1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=2107230) The Owyhee Canyonlands presents Oregon with an incredible opportunity to change this, because it's the largest conservation opportunity in the American West. In a couple weeks, our coalition partners will be heading to D.C. to deliver petitions to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands. Now is a critical time for us - we need your voice to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands as a National Monument. [**Will you take a stand for the Owyhee?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82304134/464957541/-1153890425?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzZDdkNzNmLWZiZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N3J_lfHomYYYj1A2PMvLh9a3Afhvz2HeCkuTB9WVJDE=&emci=bff20ee6-52f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=93d7d73f-fbf1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=2107230) Before stepping into my role at OLCV this February, I had never heard of the Owyhee Canyonlands. Through working at OLCV, I’ve learned a lot about this magical place and seen countless photos of the mesmerizing canyons and rock formations. From the unique plant and wildlife that live there, to the tribal sacred sites and stargazing, the Owyhee Canyonlands have something beautiful for everyone to appreciate. With all that I now know about the Owyhee, it has become the place I would like to visit most. The Owyhee Canyonlands is one of the most remote places in Oregon, which means it’s not on many people’s radar, just as it wasn’t previously for me. This was once its benefit. Now, unfortunately, the remoteness of the Owyhee Canyonlands no longer protects it. Mining and oil and gas development are encroaching, posing more threats in addition to unmanaged tourism and wildfires. This is the reason why we need to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands as a National Monument before it is too late. You don’t need to know much about the Owyhee or have been there to recognize how significant and necessary it is for these canyonlands to become a National Monument. [**Our time to act for the Owyhee Canyonlands is now.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82304135/464957542/-1153890425?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzZDdkNzNmLWZiZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N3J_lfHomYYYj1A2PMvLh9a3Afhvz2HeCkuTB9WVJDE=&emci=bff20ee6-52f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=93d7d73f-fbf1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=2107230) I hope we can protect the Owyhee before I get the chance to visit it - before it has changed too much. It only takes a moment to add your name and your voice to the list of countless others who want to save the beauty and magic of the Owyhee. With just that one moment, we can protect the Owyhee for generations. [**Will you sign our petition to let President Biden know we cannot lose this special place?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82304136/464957543/-1153890425?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjkzZDdkNzNmLWZiZjEtZWUxMS1hYWYyLTAwMjI0ODIyMzM1MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N3J_lfHomYYYj1A2PMvLh9a3Afhvz2HeCkuTB9WVJDE=&emci=bff20ee6-52f1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=93d7d73f-fbf1-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=2107230) Thank you for your voice. Sincerely,
Sarah Kline
Communications & Membership Coordinator, OLCV | |

Now, unfortunately, the remoteness of the Owyhee Canyonlands no longer protects it. Mining and oil and gas development are encroaching, posing more threats in addition to unmanaged tourism and wildfires. This is the reason why we need to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands as a National Monument before it is too late. You don’t need to know much about the Owyhee or have been there to recognize how significant and necessary it is for these canyonlands to become a National Monument. I hope we can protect the Owyhee before I get the chance to visit it - before it has changed too much. It only takes a moment to add your name and your voice to the list of countless others who want to save the beauty and magic of the Owyhee. With just that one moment, we can protect the Owyhee for generations. Thank you for your voice. * good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. subject: SB 4 is back in court today →
body:
We need your help. | | | SB 4 is back in court today, Peter. As a reminder, the Supreme Court allowed Texas’ unconstitutional law to go into effect two weeks ago, until a federal court paused the law later that night. If it were up to the Supreme Court, Texas police would currently have the power to arrest, jail, and deport migrants even **_suspected_** of crossing the border. This law is certain to open up Black and brown people and immigrants to racial profiling, discrimination, harassment, and danger. **We must continue to fight back to strike down SB4!** Other states are watching this decision closely. Florida, Arizona, and Kansas are following Governor Abbott’s lead and trying to set up their own deportation machines. If the courts allow SB 4 to go into effect, we’ll see similar laws all around the country. We **MUST** fight back now. **This is an all-hands-on-deck moment.** We need the support of this grassroots team to help fuel our fight for immigrant justice and ensure our communities in Texas know their rights. clean_body: We need your help. | | | SB 4 is back in court today, Peter. As a reminder, the Supreme Court allowed Texas’ unconstitutional law to go into effect two weeks ago, until a federal court paused the law later that night. If it were up to the Supreme Court, Texas police would currently have the power to arrest, jail, and deport migrants even suspected of crossing the border. This law is certain to open up Black and brown people and immigrants to racial profiling, discrimination, harassment, and danger. We must continue to fight back to strike down SB4! Other states are watching this decision closely. Florida, Arizona, and Kansas are following Governor Abbott’s lead and trying to set up their own deportation machines. If the courts allow SB 4 to go into effect, we’ll see similar laws all around the country. We MUST fight back now. This is an all-hands-on-deck moment. We need the support of this grassroots team to help fuel our fight for immigrant justice and ensure our communities in Texas know their rights. We won’t stop fighting for a future where all are welcomed and free to live safely. Folks, I wrote an op-ed in the _New York Times_ about the _Comstock Act_ — a 150-year-old law that the GOP is scheming to use to limit reproductive freedom for women nationwide — and how I’m planning to fight back against its usage to strip millions of women of abortion access. **[You can read the piece here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82306756/464965205/-2002289327?refcode=AU_TSM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240403_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMWE1YzU0Mi0wMmYyLWVlMTEtYWFmMi0wMDIyNDgyMjMzNTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_i8bn3Ii1VaR7D2sVseAgZngrjATSgHlUGX_7kUaeFs=&emci=20a5c542-02f2-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&emdi=21a5c542-02f2-ee11-aaf2-002248223353&ceid=6227932)** The _Comstock Act_ is an absurd, outdated piece of legislation that has not been broadly enforced for nearly a century. But Trump and his right-wing policy advisors are planning to use this legislation to make it illegal to send medication abortion and other tools to help with reproductive health care through the mail. **This would make it _significantly harder_ for women to access reproductive care — _even_ in states where abortion is legal.** As I wrote in my op-ed, “We can’t let anyone — not the Supreme Court, not Donald Trump and certainly not a random busybody from the 19th century — take away Americans’ right to access medication abortion. We must protect the ability of doctors, pharmacies and patients to receive in the mail the supplies they need to exercise their right to reproductive care.” **[Please support my work to do just that in the U.S. Senate. I’m leading the charge to repeal the _Comstock Act_ , and I’m supporting pro-choice candidates across the country. clean_body: | Folks, I wrote an op-ed in the New York Times about the Comstock Act — a 150-year-old law that the GOP is scheming to use to limit reproductive freedom for women nationwide — and how I’m planning to fight back against its usage to strip millions of women of abortion access. The Comstock Act is an absurd, outdated piece of legislation that has not been broadly enforced for nearly a century. But Trump and his right-wing policy advisors are planning to use this legislation to make it illegal to send medication abortion and other tools to help with reproductive health care through the mail. This would make it significantly harder for women to access reproductive care — even in states where abortion is legal. As I wrote in my op-ed, “We can’t let anyone — not the Supreme Court, not Donald Trump and certainly not a random busybody from the 19th century — take away Americans’ right to access medication abortion. We must protect the ability of doctors, pharmacies and patients to receive in the mail the supplies they need to exercise their right to reproductive care.” = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = I’m the only former Planned Parenthood executive in the Senate. Friend,

It’s Congressman and RSC Chair Kevin Hern. Last week, the Republican Study Committee put out our FY25 Budget proposal: Fiscal Sanity to Save America.

**_Our budget is positioned to address the federal spending problem (that DC Democrats created) and to start paying down our national debt._**

This fiscally responsible budget balances in just seven years, cuts spending by $17.1 trillion over ten years, and reduces taxes on Americans by $4.2 trillion over the next ten years.

**_Our budget is proof that it's possible to balance the budget. It's possible to operate in the black. The federal debt is daunting, but it's not hopeless. Conservative policies work together across the whole of government to lower spending, lower taxes, decrease the size and scope of the federal government, and spur economic growth._**

A strong crew of conservative leaders in the House worked hard to get this budget done a month ahead of the April 15 deadline... something that hasn’t been done in decades!

Conservatives have a plan to restore fiscal sanity - it's time to get to work!

In response to our responsible budget proposal, President Joe Biden is already spreading lies and mobilizing the Democrat war machine against fiscal conservatives who support a return to fiscal sanity in Congress. Biden wants to keep spending your tax dollars with no accountability to Congress or the American people.

[**Conservatives need your help!**](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e9d80b1a67c34da08eb7667b740d1157&_e=GRcrgfXqAuxvVH43rUyuC02e0jJv8id0-YitB5OWqcTzn2n-GVZ9fiKYiDFuVM95B32mWZ98xb0zOxp5fwEoE7cCgb1gDYEGlK76uZEXO0YQKUUPp97Eyu61QKoYKvHNzXLt2Nb5Np2rhTGsfqUbsryLxWT9jZKHrm1QrQz6-HZ7q36YjtjJsjGNCUvb1PGFEtaEy75BlZSwU4SxxXlQ8v5qyhTSUQIUsAgaglKAUAENdHaxHR42ZXclS_b6G9IdXo1F0uqtRuunOm72ajKTjZq8UpCDi_dwMiVogwIy2qtM5KgGW13qyaC7U5px4opNlr0GPFfC5JC7F-7wct516E71INed7wyGQLWc0PPlfHA%3D)

[**GET TO WORK - RUSH $15**](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e9d80b1a67c34da08eb7667b740d1157&_e=GRcrgfXqAuxvVH43rUyuC02e0jJv8id0-YitB5OWqcTzn2n-GVZ9fiKYiDFuVM95B32mWZ98xb0zOxp5fwEoE7cCgb1gDYEGlK76uZEXO0YQKUUPp97Eyu61QKoYKvHNzXLt2Nb5Np2rhTGsfqUbsgsj1KzKWhuxZCrtaz8x2AbAltsi8ae60aot2OA6yyAUPvBN1FqiJtH2ym9hb7WlOtE0OKDr_rZB29i2B6jCfFbmHWBrVmJw_p87Z9shUjFhzdRYPdYXFSdDqH6njJjAc51Fluc8lT66D_-SZtDV3AvMvw8_emjjRkshaoMFojrZWgjxIo0Fs56Vie6bShgXLzu5zElKjaJaUi05KnNwZK0%3D)
[**REVIVE AMERICA - RUSH $25**](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e9d80b1a67c34da08eb7667b740d1157&_e=GRcrgfXqAuxvVH43rUyuC02e0jJv8id0-YitB5OWqcTzn2n-GVZ9fiKYiDFuVM95B32mWZ98xb0zOxp5fwEoE7cCgb1gDYEGlK76uZEXO0YQKUUPp97Eyu61QKoYKvHNzXLt2Nb5Np2rhTGsfqUbsryLxWT9jZKHrm1QrQz6-HZ7q36YjtjJsjGNCUvb1PGFHOLstMoQCfg58gLbusI7Kr9gscj4cCxry8W3LFVkzd6Ttg1BNEoEZ0qbSSOq8cRWeQxVBvx0w9uXMVRFIBihHR2kT0vDvcCnfx2jSnBIEZeMrZ3Y52hBlbRHNvuSRsCntyD9mqX87z9-zgx2ABMYU7X6aDLEmnYu4B5JAfYsQDw%3D)
Conservatives know that we cannot continue to go down this spending path. Our budget proposal brings responsible, common sense policies to the table that will HELP ALL AMERICANS.

You see, fiscal conservatism isn’t just for Republicans. Fiscal conservatism helps EVERYONE - no matter your political affiliation, race, gender, or status.

Conservative policies will bolster the economy, lower inflation rates, slash wasteful spending, and reverse the harmful policies crushing American families. It’s about time we get America back on the right track, and it starts HERE.

[**Will you join me and my conservative allies as we fight to restore fiscal responsibility in Washington, DC?**](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e9d80b1a67c34da08eb7667b740d1157&_e=GRcrgfXqAuxvVH43rUyuC02e0jJv8id0-YitB5OWqcTzn2n-GVZ9fiKYiDFuVM95B32mWZ98xb0zOxp5fwEoE7cCgb1gDYEGlK76uZEXO0YQKUUPp97Eyu61QKoYKvHNzXLt2Nb5Np2rhTGsfqUbsryLxWT9jZKHrm1QrQz6-HZ7q36YjtjJsjGNCUvb1PGF3lNDRl6bXcFmvSeOlYBDY4l49-Hz3OyoUGFUwmkDJyaZY4NPdY_u4VcmZ14POwpFjT9gc7v_Uq5AJkoSIdEwZ-BZ5kJj-imoLncCQQ3JPaMcy7mnSTp8zQWmVeQaS8YpGjPI0S9IfzUN21o_Wlyt80vI1Flj4n2Q5XAQLZLfFxE%3D)

Ever since Trump left the White House, Biden has put America LAST. Americans are struggling to make ends meet on a weekly basis. Our budget proposal provides a blueprint for balancing our spending, securing the southern border, and defunding Biden’s Woke Agenda.

With policies like this, conservatives are one step closer to reviving our country and the American Dream. But we can’t do anything to stop Biden if Republicans lose the majority in the House of Representatives.

We MUST keep the House, win the Senate, and send President Trump back to the White House this fall. Our country’s fiscal future depends on it.

[**Can I count on you to get the job done? Your support gives House Conservatives the resources they need to put America First!**](http://links.houseconservatives.org/u/click?_t=a828c22267f2452d9c778060a3aea04e&_m=e9d80b1a67c34da08eb7667b740d1157&_e=GRcrgfXqAuxvVH43rUyuC02e0jJv8id0-YitB5OWqcTzn2n-GVZ9fiKYiDFuVM95B32mWZ98xb0zOxp5fwEoE7cCgb1gDYEGlK76uZEXO0YQKUUPp97Eyu61QKoYKvHNzXLt2Nb5Np2rhTGsfqUbsryLxWT9jZKHrm1QrQz6-HZ7q36YjtjJsjGNCUvb1PGFs3b2kTabWEoEq-S6t0KwWeIifg7WEBAXwsBW8V5OlYF5yg7hMOsQFzSmb3RxAoqf8rwG0YOHSwyq6xYB6TFH-PUpszLeBbWgwCBlp3FLvyZCxewOk2HPK4NaEpT9Flvd0mpEPNB3-1RNc-gNvmbUyujF5xFcy8puKkE676G8n-4%3D)

Thanks for your support,

Congressman Kevin Hern (OK-01)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82307230/464966585/-1463252749?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.04.03_B1_Grit_Actives_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ1ODUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDBiYTMwZDItMDRmMi1lZTExLWFhZjItMDAyMjQ4MjIzMzUzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Q5dwN1uhrsTY02JUtqOoD6yqhXnS7CzpZO1q5uP94Dk=) As a kid, I remember visiting Robert's bust. **A lot has changed since then, but my great-great-grandfather's perseverance and grit still runs in my blood.** It's helped shape me into the person I am today – and it's why I'm running for Congress to continue his legacy. body:
It is an honor to be in this fight with you

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2000%2E4032634%2EMGfwje)
---
Elizabeth said I could reach out because I wanted you to hear the news from me: **[I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2019?t=8&akid=2000%2E4032634%2EMGfwje)** When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything. Together, our A-Team has...
* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from peacefully protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.

**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted inhumanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.** [**So I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $28 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Elizabeth Warren's campaign. We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank you.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2016?amount=28&t=9&akid=2000%2E4032634%2EMGfwje)

Friend, _keeping citizens safe is the government 's number one priority, yet under our current leadership, Washington's murder rate has soared._

[](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=473f56dfaab34f80a00d03e8c32937ac&_e=Eq4FArp1zGYnhWD39B92BuSo2oIdnXUwxanaZy7UTfNOJVE_f9OEMFgs9_L6cRoE_93l5Ewnx6Wq2mzA0xUZa0URyMLfcMMVPjl2uE6YVBWqYW2SS2wv5O10lCQiU8TT7f5pQF8dtZEZyUypdxBhkHA2WSrYBBl5goZVZez9D_dSpdsNmhwu_71q7RKFxwT0toDvcgSDW5F005WBRpD6R2q5-DjMEy-i3UPsoEnLZcYN3aR6Sf7cQBnN0XGOIlPQyNP5dDhgmE2jRMQEpxORerQSVHcOby-0v7G6ERtN8tCHWZDAKCPci5roa_-32MvidRiGnvXhHBR4BAv12iUb769yPTmncG0IBTjmw8eiCA_MYdg1r0a0Av1h33J8zGzr3HRukFARmM_7QItJYwI9Og%3D%3D)

Under Governor Inslee and Attorney General Bob Ferguson, WA's murder rate has hit an all-time high. They have led the charge on anti-public safety laws, and now Washingtonians are paying for their failed leadership with their lives.

Looking at stats from the WA Association of Sheriffs and Police Chiefs, murder rates have skyrocketed since 2012 and are up 96% from 2019. Murder isn't the only crime soring under Ferguson's watch - rape, assault, and property crimes have also all increased. These stats aren't just numbers; these are people who are our families and friends.

| [**PROTECT WASHINGTON**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=473f56dfaab34f80a00d03e8c32937ac&_e=Eq4FArp1zGYnhWD39B92BuSo2oIdnXUwxanaZy7UTfNOJVE_f9OEMFgs9_L6cRoE_93l5Ewnx6Wq2mzA0xUZa0URyMLfcMMVPjl2uE6YVBWqYW2SS2wv5O10lCQiU8TT7f5pQF8dtZEZyUypdxBhkHA2WSrYBBl5goZVZez9D_dSpdsNmhwu_71q7RKFxwT0toDvcgSDW5F005WBRpD6R60ILp4CbMhQxUOBVqchz1Q8_TQy5_qirA2J2A8zDu-5zvoO-eYwP_GOMTbEDg_y_AdOMDur1VTW2NJgdJ_yQvjtbLVgX7s24ziWFFEPpfzkPZRCvCsZSXmeKWW8HR5XdCc9sWkbfjJGHqOQqF8JKxwSCHEChdJkpDVzKv2VpjlHh6Ia4eGratCjCAJxdWAiybhCLVg24f5BKYXzv8LbSmU%3D)

[**PROTECT OUR CITIZENS**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=473f56dfaab34f80a00d03e8c32937ac&_e=Eq4FArp1zGYnhWD39B92BuSo2oIdnXUwxanaZy7UTfNOJVE_f9OEMFgs9_L6cRoE_93l5Ewnx6Wq2mzA0xUZa0URyMLfcMMVPjl2uE6YVBWqYW2SS2wv5O10lCQiU8TT7f5pQF8dtZEZyUypdxBhkHA2WSrYBBl5goZVZez9D_dSpdsNmhwu_71q7RKFxwT0toDvcgSDW5F005WBRpD6R60ILp4CbMhQxUOBVqchz1Q8_TQy5_qirA2J2A8zDu-5G586J1Mia00RgGVBZ_ErL9NS85dEZZuWEye2Kjcqv73earpNKE_x2oNYCqVqITiCcWBe9Oufg0P8sdi5FyGPsjxFuLrXnlFXBibx6dL_Hhyw3BpjhlsmkAaKHRoZD9H1WyxFRCnapbV_80QuMfvIIQ25fEFKgYDSYjBbBQ1Gj7k%3D)

_**As a former Sheriff, I have caught criminals and defended citizens. I 'm ready to stand up for Washingtonians once again. Together, we'll change what's wrong, fix what's broken, and do what's right.**_

We believe every family deserves the freedom to choose where and how their children are educated –– **_and that’s why we’re working to keep Catholic schools open_** _. _

[**SIGN THE PETITION: KEEP CATHOLIC SCHOOLS OPEN**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4246f58650e3486d8b26985e5d59ae4e&_e=kRHMfZNz2HIe28pw3HcZaINc9gHY_YIRbz0C2TyuYh9zruth5SzXhOGMj8RRdWHeJVpMRtX2EEkY7DBpQ5uz1Zks4xDfEZkvm6_bSvUkqt3Su5q0WlkzCTM0F9fBU2FrWAm8h9aLD8VSZIrRQrAPugUYBbREHy5IRd7jNq5JZW0hUp5Niab3cxCWXnfG14HFPx0jVbVKhbrORrwfLpTCjLnkQphmTkaVYluptylgVJkJRA3-fDp1QWanV5PZ9gahzhTiGy4jBhODH4obhmGMEqRAvgztVA76yUzRvWjgoK2GQ_rVdVjPdOdPp_iHdn2dppKXyWJyoaKu6ttZw527T05qAgcLDXuJ-yvEpZ7kFjZ7EKOeNRxdLc9RYV0QhAVZEfPaDSuzUGN6THRKOddmUNjhyHM0FyfrFZKb0o7h8wbFMLzsoSiBQ4v8jmsNDufHTZ7wnPJR1r0xQ4S_ksmb2c9j9Lle-WBApPlcPqWI8VU%3D)
---
Right now, 1.6 million American children are enrolled in Catholic schools, but the school system they love is under threat of extinction –– **especially** in states that don’t allow taxpayers to direct education tax dollars to private schools.

For many families, their local Catholic school is the only available alternative to the public school system. **And if their school closes, their access to school choice can disappear overnight.**
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: SAVE CATHOLIC SCHOOLS**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4246f58650e3486d8b26985e5d59ae4e&_e=kRHMfZNz2HIe28pw3HcZaINc9gHY_YIRbz0C2TyuYh9zruth5SzXhOGMj8RRdWHeJVpMRtX2EEkY7DBpQ5uz1Zks4xDfEZkvm6_bSvUkqt3Su5q0WlkzCTM0F9fBU2FrWAm8h9aLD8VSZIrRQrAPugUYBbREHy5IRd7jNq5JZW0hUp5Niab3cxCWXnfG14HFPx0jVbVKhbrORrwfLpTCjLnkQphmTkaVYluptylgVJkJRA3-fDp1QWanV5PZ9gahzhTiGy4jBhODH4obhmGMEqRAvgztVA76yUzRvWjgoK2GQ_rVdVjPdOdPp_iHdn2dppKXyWJyoaKu6ttZw527T1KyBBhOQBgqYoQPwmAdSu1uhdoZNLRigWEIF3YybbAFeaJx_boWYqNa92YRVdvuELZ0gW0I0zk3BWyhgaNhZvJJWs5ZTxHsSHUGWEFEgQ6Mr8WalT1MVFlqHEJeM6CB0h4L2G9cZ7C12k_B7CAiTbM%3D)
---
**This is the withering of educational options in our most at-risk neighborhoods. **

__Because these schools aren't just for Catholics. __

There's a beautiful phrase you will hear from Catholic educators: "We don't teach these kids because _they're_ Catholic. We teach because _we're_ Catholic."

Catholic schools don't just open where there is existing parent wealth. As a charitable work, they serve many communities where quality education is lacking.

**Peter, this is why we fight for school choice –– and supporters like you are making a powerful impact every day.**
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: DEFEND SCHOOL CHOICE**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=4246f58650e3486d8b26985e5d59ae4e&_e=kRHMfZNz2HIe28pw3HcZaINc9gHY_YIRbz0C2TyuYh9zruth5SzXhOGMj8RRdWHeJVpMRtX2EEkY7DBpQ5uz1Zks4xDfEZkvm6_bSvUkqt3Su5q0WlkzCTM0F9fBU2FrWAm8h9aLD8VSZIrRQrAPugUYBbREHy5IRd7jNq5JZW0hUp5Niab3cxCWXnfG14HFPx0jVbVKhbrORrwfLpTCjLnkQphmTkaVYluptylgVJkJRA3-fDp1QWanV5PZ9gahzhTiGy4jBhODH4obhmGMEqRAvgztVA76yUzRvWjgoK2GQ_rVdVjPdOdPp_iHdn2dppKXyWJyoaKu6ttZw527T8W7y_M92JTRl1wJ8mfE6q2roQ71mWPDWBOSVxWlXHODZ0jYMt9aEWg8xNdI1xOk-qCHTaM84ICCXW55UmHLNOBmTxveIUJUjbaeEtkWcdQyUu-SWo39gxRmpR_UPNMJLptev3_n5YKwIE10x_33oKc%3D)

[We Must Free Assange Now!](https://www.kennedy24.com/assange-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_p2_4_3_24_nd1&n=5)

Think about that a moment: Freedom of the Press = The Death Penalty. _In what universe are we living?_
If the US Military successfully covers-up their war crimes by locking up Assange – or worse – they will put a massive chilling effect on the First Amendment Freedom of the Press guarantee in the Constitution.

name: Ayanna Pressley
subject: A big announcement from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I wanted you to hear the news from me: **I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District.**
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. **“What has changed” they ask? Everything.**
Together, our A-Team has...
• Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
• Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
• Advocated for justice for the people, from peacefully protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.
**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making.** We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted inhumanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.
[So I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $5 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Alexandria. We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank you.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240403-ap.Q6TqY2&refcode=em20240403-6133-P_FND_SPL_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6133%2E2526796%2EjAHV9k)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240403-ap.Q6TqY2&refcode=em20240403-6133-P_FND_SPL_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=6133%2E2526796%2EjAHV9k)**
Six years ago, this team elected the first Black woman and first person of color to represent Massachusetts in Congress — but this movement is about so much more than that.
I told this team that if you sent me to Washington, I wasn’t going alone. I was bringing all of you with me. You all are my teachers, my partners, and my accomplices. The issues that you care about are the issues I fight for.
By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of every person who has been left out and left behind.
You are sending a message that corporate interests should never win over working people.
You’re affirming that abortion is health care.
That a college education should move us forward, not set us back.
That Black men deserve to grow old.
That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti.
That this movement is STRONG.
I love the Massachusetts 7th district.
[It is an honor to represent the people of the Massachusetts 7th, and this movement, in Congress. If you can, please split a donation of $5 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Alexandria's during this important moment.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240403-ap.Q6TqY2&refcode=em20240403-6133-P_FND_SPL_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6133%2E2526796%2EjAHV9k)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240403-ap.Q6TqY2&refcode=em20240403-6133-P_FND_SPL_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6133%2E2526796%2EjAHV9k)**
Your Congresswoman,
Ayanna

That means abortion access is in jeopardy everywhere, even in states where it's legal. It's been nearly two years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe. And here we are again, at another crossroads that could make it even tougher to access safe, legal abortion. This is the fruit of Donald Trump’s long-term plan, friend: Pack the courts, chisel away at abortion rights, and leave millions of Americans without life-saving health care access. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Now, more than ever, we need to stand strong for federal laws that make sure everyone in the U.S. has access to the reproductive care they need — from our representatives in the House all the way up to the President’s desk. We cannot allow the GOP to maintain their positions of power. Anyone who views a post-Roe America as the ideal scenario does not have our best interests in mind. = = Thanks for sticking with us, Swalwell SCOTUS Watch | | | = = Text ERIC to 43033 to get text updates! Democrat Eric Swalwell proudly represents California's 14th Congressional District. He needs your support in order to keep protecting what's important: our healthcare, our paychecks, our future, and our democracy. | | = Eric runs a people-powered campaign that relies on grassroots supporters like you, and if he's going to win re-election, he's going to need your help. name: Bob Casey
subject: Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
Derek, in a moment, I’m going to share why I’m running for re-election, but first I am asking:
[**Can you split $5 or more between me and John Fetterman to build a winning campaign capable of taking on my billionaire-backed opponent?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)
**[Chip in »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)**
Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be.
It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our family.
It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been about fighting for Pennsylvania families.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)
I chose to make Scranton my home because of the people. I enjoy that in Scranton, saying “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the grocery store checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you about what you’re buying and about your family, too.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)
Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m proud of the fights we’ve won together.
I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win together – like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’ rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)
The reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent is worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. **That’s why Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this seat.**
This is going to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Nation, and we have to be ready to fight back against millions upon millions in outside spending if we’re going to win.
[**With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your support is more important than ever. So what do you say? Will you split a donation between my campaign and John Fetterman's to keep PA and the Senate blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-8895&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)**
With gratitude,
Bob Casey
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240403-1?refcode=em20240403-1&amount=5&refcode2=8895_434096_VgsXcL&akid=8895%2E434096%2EVgsXcL)

| | Last week, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in a case brought to them by far-right anti-abortion activists hoping to rip away access to the abortion medication, mifepristone. Mifepristone accounts for 70% of all abortions nationwide. **If the Court sides with these right-wing extremists, their ruling will restrict access to mifepristone — even in states where abortion is still legal, like Oregon.** In 1990, I chaired the first-ever Congressional hearing on mifepristone, and started leading the charge to help get this medication onto the market. Over 30 years later, I can't believe I still have to say what I said back then: this should be about science over politics, plain and simple. Far-right extremists are basing their case on false claims. In fact, this case _never_ should have made it before the Supreme Court. The extremists propelling this case forward relied on a dangerous practice known as "judge shopping," when activist plaintiffs guarantee their case will be heard by judges they know will rule in their favor. In this case, the far-right chose a judge in Texas – hand-picked by Donald Trump – to hand them the ruling they were hoping for. **This case has nothing to do with science and everything to do with Republicans' perverse obsession with controlling women's bodies.** Just like I've been doing for the last 30 years, I'm going to keep fighting with everything I've got to reject Republican attempts to rip away our fundamental freedoms. But this also underscores just how critical it is to protect our razor-thin majority in the Senate so we can continue to confirm judges nationwide who will stand on the side of the law, not politics. Between now and November, I'm going to be working as hard as I can to protect and expand our majority in the Senate, and I hope you'll stand with me. clean_body: | | | | Last week, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in a case brought to them by far-right anti-abortion activists hoping to rip away access to the abortion medication, mifepristone. Mifepristone accounts for 70% of all abortions nationwide. If the Court sides with these right-wing extremists, their ruling will restrict access to mifepristone — even in states where abortion is still legal, like Oregon. In 1990, I chaired the first-ever Congressional hearing on mifepristone, and started leading the charge to help get this medication onto the market. Over 30 years later, I can't believe I still have to say what I said back then: this should be about science over politics, plain and simple. Far-right extremists are basing their case on false claims. In fact, this case never should have made it before the Supreme Court. The extremists propelling this case forward relied on a dangerous practice known as "judge shopping," when activist plaintiffs guarantee their case will be heard by judges they know will rule in their favor. In this case, the far-right chose a judge in Texas – hand-picked by Donald Trump – to hand them the ruling they were hoping for. This case has nothing to do with science and everything to do with Republicans' perverse obsession with controlling women's bodies. Just like I've been doing for the last 30 years, I'm going to keep fighting with everything I've got to reject Republican attempts to rip away our fundamental freedoms. But this also underscores just how critical it is to protect our razor-thin majority in the Senate so we can continue to confirm judges nationwide who will stand on the side of the law, not politics. Between now and November, I'm going to be working as hard as I can to protect and expand our majority in the Senate, and I hope you'll stand with me.
